# Discrete Diffusion LM 的 NVFP4 量化调研

## 1. DFlash / discrete diffusion LM 量化现状（最关键）

**结论：DFlash 本身没有公开 W4A4 / NVFP4 PTQ 论文，但 discrete diffusion LM (LLaDA / Dream) 的 4-bit 量化已有 3 篇专门工作 + 业界已经在 NVFP4 下跑 DFlash draft（社区代码实证）。**

### 1.1 直接证据：DFlash + NVFP4 已在生产部署

- **AEON-7 / Qwen3.6-27B-AEON-DFlash**（GitHub + HF）：原文 "Lossless abliteration of Qwen3.6-27B with **NVFP4 hardware quantization for DGX Spark / Blackwell**. BF16 (51 GB) + NVFP4 (26 GB) deployment guide" ([HF](https://huggingface.co/AEON-7/Qwen3.6-27B-AEON-Ultimate-Uncensored-NVFP4) / [GitHub](https://github.com/AEON-7/Qwen3.6-27B-AEON-Ultimate-Uncensored-DFlash))。**这是实证**：DFlash draft + NVFP4 已经能跑通。
- **vLLM speculators 项目**（[GitHub](https://github.com/vllm-project/speculators)）：DFlash 算法支持已合入；RedHatAI 的 [gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.dflash](https://huggingface.co/RedHatAI/gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.dflash) 是生产 draft，vLLM Issue #38240 跟进 DFlash speculator 集成。
- vLLM 官方文档已收录 [Dflash speculator 用户指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/speculators/en/latest/user_guide/algorithms/dflash/)。

### 1.2 直接证据：discrete diffusion LM 4-bit PTQ 三篇论文

| 论文 | 来源 | 模型 | 关键结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **QDLM / "Quantization Meets dLLMs"** | [arXiv:2508.14896](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14896) / [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixMessi/QDLM) | LLaDA-8B-Base/Instruct, Dream 7B-Base | **W4-only GPTQ near-lossless**（4-bit GPTQ LLaDA-8B-Instruct 6 个 QA 任务 65.7%→66.0%，MATH/GSM8K 仅 -0.6%）；**W4A4 大坑** —— massive outliers 跨更多 token（不像 AR LLM 集中在少数 token），SmoothQuant/QuaRot/DuQuant 推荐 DuQuant |
| **DLLMQuant** | [arXiv:2508.14090](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.14090) | LLaDA | 三件套 TMAS（Temporal-Mask Adaptive Sampling 校准）+ IA-AQ（双向 attention 感知激活量化）+ CGQ（mask 状态进入 GPTQ 误差补偿）。**4-bit 下 GSM8K 比 baseline +10 点** |
| **Quant-dLLM** | [arXiv:2510.03274](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03274) / [GitHub](https://github.com/ZTA2785/Quant-dLLM) | LLaDA-8B-Base | 极低比特（**2-bit**）；MCS+DAQ+ABMP；2-bit LLaDA-8B 平均分 42.39%→54.06%，保留 87.72% FP 精度 |

**核心病理**（三篇都同意）：discrete diffusion LM 的量化难点是**迭代去噪过程中**：
- (a) 每个 timestep 的激活分布不同（mask ratio 变化）
- (b) 误差跨 timestep **累积**
- (c) **活跃 token outliers 跨更广**（vs AR LLM 集中在 sink/few token）—— 这是 W4A4 比 W4-only 难一档的核心原因

### 1.3 对你的判断
**问"有没有人对 block diffusion text LM 做 W4A4/NVFP4？"答**：W4-only PTQ 已实证 near-lossless（GPTQ 4-bit 几乎不掉点）；**W4A4 / NVFP4（act 也 4-bit）目前没看到公开 paper 实测**，但社区 NVFP4 部署存在，工程层面可推。**没看到失败报告**，但 QDLM 的 W4A4 数据明显比 W4-only 差。

---

## 2. 可借鉴的 DiT FP4 量化 trick

**SVDQuant + NVFP4 是当前 SOTA 视觉 DiT FP4 工作**（[MIT-Han Lab Blog](https://hanlab.mit.edu/blog/svdquant-nvfp4) / [arXiv:2411.05007](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.05007) / [Nunchaku GitHub](https://github.com/nunchaku-ai/nunchaku)）。RTX 5090 上 FLUX 跑出 **3× over BF16**、**3.1× over W4A16**，质量优于 INT4。

| Trick | 原理 | 能否搬到 block diffusion text LM |
|---|---|---|
| **SVDQuant 低秩分支吸收 outlier** | 把 act outlier shift 到 weight，再 SVD 抽 rank-32 旁路用 FP16 跑，主路 FP4 | **强可搬**。QDLM 已确认 dLLM activation outlier 比 AR LLM 更广，SVD 旁路天生克这个；DFlash draft 5 层小，rank-32 开销极低 |
| **Timestep-aware 校准**（PTQ4DM / PTQD / Q-Diffusion / Mixup-Sign CVPR'25） | 视觉 diffusion 50+ step，每 step act 分布不同，单点校准失败 | **理论可搬，但 DFlash 是 block diffusion，一个 block 内 1 次 forward**（不像视觉 50 step 迭代），timestep 维度退化为 block index，校准复杂度低很多。DLLMQuant 的 TMAS / Quant-dLLM 的 MCS 已是 text 版的对应方案 |
| **shortcut layer 双峰激活校准**（Q-Diffusion） | 视觉 UNet skip connection 做 bimodal calib | DFlash 没 UNet，**不可搬** |
| **NVFP4 microscaling group=16** vs MXFP4 group=32 | 动态范围更细 | **直接受益**。本仓库已用，draft FC 层就是 NVFP4 |
| **Mixup-Sign FP4 (MSFP) + TALoRA**（CVPR'25） | timestep-aware LoRA 修复量化误差 | **强可搬**。DFlash draft 5 层 ≈ 65M/层，挂 LoRA per-block-position 修复 W4A4 误差，参数开销 < 5% |

**论文实证 vs 理论推断**：SVDQuant + NVFP4 数据是 NVIDIA 官方 + MIT 实证（FLUX、SDXL、PixArt）；时间步校准在视觉 diffusion 实证；**搬到 block diffusion text LM 的"实证"目前只有 DLLMQuant/Quant-dLLM 的非 SVDQuant 路径**。

---

## 3. NVFP4 spec decoding draft 数据点

| 数据 | 来源 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| NVFP4 MMLU-Pro / GPQA 精度 | NVIDIA blog | DeepSeek-R1-0528 FP8→NVFP4 精度差 <1% |
| Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 on 4×RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120) | [HF discussion](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4/discussions/7) / [vLLM forum](https://discuss.vllm.ai/t/sm120-rtx-pro-6000-nvfp4-moe-performance-report-qwen3-5-397b/2536) | **当前 sm_120 best 50.5 tok/s**（Marlin W4A16 fallback）；理论 native NVFP4 fast path 应 100-150 tok/s。**[FlashInfer Issue #2577](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/issues/2577) / [CUTLASS #3096](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/issues/3096)**：CUTLASS TMA WS grouped GEMM 在 sm_120 失败，需要 compute_120f patch（CUDA 13.0 后部分修复） |
| RTX PRO 6000 NVFP4-W4A4 throughput | edge-ai-vision blog | 6000-8000 tok/s（small model，最佳 path） |
| vLLM MTP + Marlin NVFP4 path | vLLM issue（papers.md 13.9 已记录） | **-22% throughput** —— activation distribution mismatch |
| EAGLE-3 + NVFP4 draft 论文 | 没找到直接论文 | NVIDIA Model-Optimizer 库 + RedHatAI gemma-4 dflash 是工程证据，**没看到 quality/speedup 系统 paper** |

**结论**：NVFP4 draft 在 sm_120 (RTX 6000D) 当前**仍处于 kernel 不稳期**。本仓库的"b12x 2-tier + Marlin 兜底"方案（CLAUDE.md "Decode kernel 派发"）和社区证据完全一致 —— **不要假定 NVFP4 fast path 能跑满**。

---

## 4. 直接落地建议（对 DFlash MiniCPM-SALA draft 做 NVFP4）

**架构推荐**：W4-only NVFP4 PTQ（attention QKV 不量化，按 NVIDIA modelopt `nvfp4_mlp_only` / `nvfp4_omlp_only` 推荐配置）。
- 来源：[NVIDIA TensorRT-Model-Optimizer llm_ptq README](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Optimizer/blob/main/examples/llm_ptq/README.md) 明确推荐 attention 不量化以保 acc。

**具体路线**：

1. **PTQ vs QAT**：先 **PTQ (GPTQ + 离散 mask 校准)**。理由：
   - QDLM 实证 W4-only GPTQ on LLaDA near-lossless（[arXiv:2508.14896](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14896)）
   - DFlash draft 只 5 层，比 LLaDA 8B 简单 —— **如果 8B 都能 near-lossless，5 层小 draft 几乎肯定行**
   - QAT 数据流要重做（target hidden 5 层 + denoising loss），训练投入大
   - 失败再上 QAT，QDLM/Quant-dLLM 没有用 QAT

2. **校准数据**：用 **DLLMQuant TMAS** 思路 —— 抽 block-level mask ratio 不同的样本（block 内 pos 0=clean、pos 1..15=mask；多种 partial-acc 场景）。**禁用 bench/data/**（CLAUDE.md 红线）。用 calib_wikitext_loguniform_128 同源策略生成 dflash 校准集。

3. **工具链**：
   - 主路：**llmcompressor** 或 **GPTQModel**（本仓库 demo-sala 已有 GPTQ 路径）；按 dLLM 习惯加 mask-aware calibration sampler
   - 替代：**NVIDIA modelopt** `nvfp4_omlp_only`（attention QKV 不量化 + MLP 量化）—— 这是 NVIDIA 推荐 NVFP4 LLM 配方
   - **不要用 W4A4 SmoothQuant/QuaRot 直接套** —— QDLM 实证在 dLLM 上 SmoothQuant 退化大

4. **预计踩坑**：
   - **mask_token (id=73447) 的 embedding 是 outlier 重灾区**。DFlash 单 token 占整个分支 entry，校准时一定要让 mask_token 出现在 input 里
   - **5 层 cross-attention 的 K/V 投影对 target hidden 敏感**。target hidden 是 5 层拼接（5×4096=20480），pre-quant range 比 standard hidden 大 5×。建议**保 K/V 投影 INT8 或 BF16**，只量化 Q + MLP
   - **sm_120 NVFP4 GEMM 路径不稳**（CUTLASS #3096、FlashInfer #2577）。draft 形状小（hidden=2560 / 5 层），**Marlin W4A16 兜底大概率胜过 NVFP4 fast path** —— 与本仓库 SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48 的现有结论一致
   - DFlash 一次 forward 出 16 token，**logits 误差跨 16 个 position 累积**；不像 AR draft 错了立即 reject。需要 per-block-position bias 校准（类比 PTQD 的 variance schedule calibration）

5. **预期收益**（保守估计）：
   - **Memory**：DFlash draft 5 层 × hidden=2560 ≈ 800M-1B params。BF16 ~2 GB → NVFP4 ~0.5 GB（**-75%**），释放给 KV cache / verify tree
   - **Speed**：sm_120 当前现实是 **Marlin W4A16 ≈ 1.5-2× over BF16**（本仓库已实测）；理论 NVFP4 fast path 修好后 2.5-3×。draft 占 EAGLE 端到端 ~30%，draft 2× ⇒ **e2e ~10-15% speedup**
   - **Quality**：QDLM W4-only LLaDA 8B 几乎不掉点；DFlash 5 层小 draft 期望 **accept_len 退化 < 3%**

**判断（论文证据 vs 推断）**：
- 论文/代码实证：QDLM 4-bit GPTQ near-lossless（实证）/ AEON-7 DFlash+NVFP4 部署（代码实证）/ SVDQuant NVFP4 DiT 3× 加速（实证）/ Marlin NVFP4 sm_120 不稳（社区 issue 实证）
- 理论推断：DFlash 5 层走 PTQ 几乎肯定通；TALoRA / SVD low-rank 旁路搬到 dLLM；K/V 投影对 target hidden 敏感

```
95	# ── STE round (legacy fake-quant path) ────────────────────────────────────
96	
97	def _fp4_round(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
98	    """Round each element to the nearest FP4 E2M1 representable value.
99	
100	    Input: any float tensor (preferably already in [-6, 6]).
101	    Output: same dtype, values in {0, ±0.5, ±1, ±1.5, ±2, ±3, ±4, ±6}.
102	    """
103	    pos = _FP4_POS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
104	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
105	    sign = x.sign()
106	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds)
107	    return sign * pos[idx]
108	
109	
110	class _FP4QuantSTE(torch.autograd.Function):
111	    """Fake-quantize weight to FP4 E2M1 in forward; straight-through in backward.
112	
113	    Per-group-of-16 scaling: ``scale = max(|w_group|) / 6.0``. Stays in the
114	    weight's native dtype (bf16); only the per-group scale (1 value per 16
115	    weights) goes through fp32 for clamp stability.
116	    """
117	    @staticmethod
118	    def forward(ctx, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
119	        N, K = weight.shape
120	        w_g = weight.reshape(N, K // FP4_GROUP_SIZE, FP4_GROUP_SIZE)
121	        abs_max = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
122	        scale = (abs_max.float().clamp(min=1e-8) / 6.0).to(weight.dtype)
123	        w_q = _fp4_round(w_g / scale) * scale
124	        return w_q.reshape(N, K)
125	
126	    @staticmethod
127	    def backward(ctx, grad: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
128	        return grad  # STE
129	
130	
131	# ── True 4-bit forward path (NVFP4 cutlass) ───────────────────────────────
132	
133	def _compute_global_scale(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
134	    """Per-tensor input_global_scale matching the NVFP4 reference."""
135	    amax = t.detach().abs().amax().to(torch.float32).clamp(min=1e-6)
136	    return (_FP4_E4M3_E2M1_PRODUCT / amax).view(1)
137	
138	
139	class _NVFP4LinearFn(torch.autograd.Function):
140	    """Forward: NVFP4 GEMM (true 4-bit). Backward: bf16 STE.
141	
142	    NVFP4 official scale convention applied so input_global_scale * input fits
143	    the joint FP4*E4M3 dynamic range. ``alpha = 1 / (gs_x * gs_w)`` descales
144	    the output back to the original magnitude. Without this, weights with
145	    small amax (e.g. ~0.01 after init_mlp_from_target) trigger e4m3 underflow
146	    and the GEMM produces NaN on entire blocks.
147	
148	    STE backward: forward uses the FP4-quantized weight, but the gradient
149	    w.r.t. the master bf16 weight is the standard linear gradient
150	    (grad_w = grad_out.T @ x), identical to the legacy fake-quant STE.
151	    """
152	    @staticmethod
153	    def forward(ctx, x, weight_bf16, wq, wsf, w_gs):
154	        _maybe_load_nvfp4_autotune()
155	        x2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
156	        x_gs = _compute_global_scale(x2d)
157	        xq, xsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(x2d, x_gs)
158	        alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).contiguous()
159	        out2d = _fi_mm_fp4(
160	            xq, wq.T, xsf, wsf.T, alpha,
161	            out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
162	            block_size=16, use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass",
163	        )
164	        out_shape = list(x.shape[:-1]) + [out2d.shape[-1]]
165	        ctx.save_for_backward(x, weight_bf16)
166	        return out2d.view(out_shape)
167	
168	    @staticmethod
169	    def backward(ctx, grad_out):
170	        x, w = ctx.saved_tensors
171	        grad_out_2d = grad_out.reshape(-1, grad_out.shape[-1])
172	        x_2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
173	        grad_x = (grad_out_2d @ w).view_as(x)
174	        grad_w = grad_out_2d.t() @ x_2d
175	        return grad_x, grad_w, None, None, None
176	
177	
178	# ── Linear wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
179	
180	class FP4QATLinear(nn.Linear):
181	    """nn.Linear with FP4 fake-quantization on weights during training.
182	
183	    Eval / FP4_QAT=False / ``_fp4_skip=True``: plain bf16 ``F.linear`` so the
184	    final RTN export matches inference exactly.
185	    """
186	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
187	        if not (self.training and FP4_QAT):
188	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
189	        if getattr(self, "_fp4_skip", False):
190	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
191	
192	        if NVFP4_FORWARD:
193	            wq = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_packed", None)
194	            wsf = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_sf", None)
195	            w_gs = getattr(self, "_fp4_w_gs", None)
196	            if wq is None:
197	                w_gs = _compute_global_scale(self.weight)
198	                wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(self.weight, w_gs)
199	            out = _NVFP4LinearFn.apply(x, self.weight, wq, wsf, w_gs)
200	            return out if self.bias is None else (out + self.bias)
201	
202	        # Legacy fake-STE (bf16 GEMM, FP4-rounded weight).
203	        qw = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw", None)
204	        if qw is None:
205	            qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(self.weight)
206	        return F.linear(x, qw, self.bias)
207	
208	
209	def fp4_quant_freeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
210	    """Pre-quantize every FP4QATLinear weight so multi-step forwards reuse it.
211	
212	    NVFP4_FORWARD=1: caches packed (wq, wsf, w_gs) — weight quantize cost is
213	    paid once per optimizer step instead of TTT_STEPS times.
214	    NVFP4_FORWARD=0: caches fake-STE quantized weight (bf16 tensor).
215	    """
216	    if not FP4_QAT:
217	        return
218	    for m in model.modules():
219	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear) and m.training:
220	            if getattr(m, "_fp4_skip", False):
221	                continue
222	            if NVFP4_FORWARD:
223	                with torch.no_grad():
224	                    w_gs = _compute_global_scale(m.weight)
225	                    wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(m.weight, w_gs)
226	                m._fp4_qw_packed = wq
227	                m._fp4_qw_sf = wsf
228	                m._fp4_w_gs = w_gs
229	            else:
230	                m._fp4_qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(m.weight)
231	
232	
233	def fp4_quant_unfreeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
234	    """Clear the per-step quantized-weight cache after backward."""
235	    for m in model.modules():
236	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear):
237	            m._fp4_qw = None
238	            m._fp4_qw_packed = None
239	            m._fp4_qw_sf = None
240	            m._fp4_w_gs = None
241
```

```
1	"""EAGLE-3 draft architecture primitives, no trainer/data logic.
2	
3	Constants, RMSNorm, RoPE helpers, Eagle3Attention/MLP/DecoderLayer.
4	
5	Architecture matches MiniCPM-SALA layer 16 (HIDDEN_SIZE=4096, NUM_HEADS=32,
6	NUM_KV_HEADS=2, INTERMEDIATE_SIZE=16384). Constants are exposed as module
7	attributes so trainers can read them without re-declaring.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import math
12	
13	import torch
14	import torch.nn as nn
15	import torch.nn.functional as F
16	
17	from eagle.core.fp4_quant import FP4QATLinear
18	
19	
20	# ── Architecture constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────
21	
22	HIDDEN_SIZE = 4096
23	AUX_DIM = HIDDEN_SIZE * 3   # 12288 — concat of three target hidden layers
24	VOCAB_SIZE = 73448
25	DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE = 32000
26	NUM_HEADS = 32
27	NUM_KV_HEADS = 2
28	HEAD_DIM = 128
29	INTERMEDIATE_SIZE = 16384
30	RMS_NORM_EPS = 1e-6
31	
32	ROPE_THETA = 10000.0   # MiniCPM-SALA config.rope_theta (default; v4 overrides)
33	
34	
35	# ── RMSNorm ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36	
37	class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
38	    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float = RMS_NORM_EPS):
39	        super().__init__()
40	        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))
41	        self.eps = eps
42	
43	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
44	        norm = x.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True).add(self.eps).rsqrt()
45	        return (x * norm).to(x.dtype) * self.weight
46	
47	
48	# ── RoPE helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
49	
50	def build_rope_cache(head_dim: int, max_seq: int, theta: float = ROPE_THETA):
51	    """Returns (cos, sin) of shape (max_seq, head_dim/2), fp32."""
52	    inv_freq = 1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / head_dim))
53	    t = torch.arange(max_seq, dtype=torch.float32)
54	    freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)   # (max_seq, head_dim/2)
55	    return torch.cos(freqs), torch.sin(freqs)
56	
57	
58	def apply_rotary_pos_emb(x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor,
59	                         position_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
60	    """Apply neox-style RoPE to x: (B, num_heads, S, head_dim).
61	
62	    cos/sin: (max_seq, head_dim/2). position_ids: (B, S).
63	    """
64	    cos_pos = cos[position_ids].unsqueeze(1)   # (B, 1, S, head_dim/2)
65	    sin_pos = sin[position_ids].unsqueeze(1)
66	    x1 = x[..., :x.shape[-1] // 2]
67	    x2 = x[..., x.shape[-1] // 2:]
68	    return torch.cat([x1 * cos_pos - x2 * sin_pos,
69	                      x2 * cos_pos + x1 * sin_pos], dim=-1)
70	
71	
72	# ── Attention (list-based KV cache for TTT) ───────────────────────────────
73	
74	class Eagle3Attention(nn.Module):
75	    """EAGLE-3 attention with list-based KV cache across TTT steps + RoPE.
76	
77	    Step 0: SDPA. Single-doc → flash via ``is_causal=True``. Multi-doc
78	    (packed) → matrix path via ``packed_attn_mask``.
79	
80	    Step k>0: cache_k[0] cross-position + cache_k[i>=1] self-position. Single
81	    softmax over (S + n_extra) keys; ``n_extra`` entries are diagonal — q[p]
82	    only sees cache_k[i][p].
83	    """
84	    def __init__(self, rope_max_seq: int = 18496, rope_theta: float = ROPE_THETA):
85	        super().__init__()
86	        self.num_heads = NUM_HEADS
87	        self.num_kv_heads = NUM_KV_HEADS
88	        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
89	        self.num_kv_groups = NUM_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS
90	
91	        qkv_in = HIDDEN_SIZE * 2  # cat(embed, hidden)
92	        self.q_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
93	        self.k_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
94	        self.v_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
95	        self.o_proj = FP4QATLinear(NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False)
96	
97	        cos, sin = build_rope_cache(HEAD_DIM, max_seq=rope_max_seq, theta=rope_theta)
98	        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", cos, persistent=False)
99	        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", sin, persistent=False)
100
```

```
2	"""
3	Convert EAGLE-3 training checkpoint to sglang-compatible format.
4	
5	When FP4_QAT=True (default), packs BF16 master weights into NVFP4 format
6	(weight_packed uint8 + weight_scale fp8 + weight_scale_2 f32) so the
7	sglang model can be loaded with quantization="modelopt_fp4" and Marlin
8	W4A16 dispatch.  No post-training optimization — weights trained with
9	FP4QATLinear are already on the FP4 grid.
10	
11	Produces a directory with:
12	  - config.json (LlamaConfig-compatible, quantization_config set for NVFP4)
13	  - model.safetensors (weights: NVFP4 for linear layers, BF16 for norms)
14	
15	Usage:
16	    python3 eagle/convert_to_sglang.py

53	# ── NVFP4 packing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	# FP4 E2M1 values and rounding boundaries
56	_FP4_POS = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
57	_FP4_BOUNDS = torch.tensor([0.25, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0])
58	
59	
60	def _fp4_round(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
61	    """Round to nearest FP4 E2M1 value (float output)."""
62	    pos = _FP4_POS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
63	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
64	    sign = x.sign()
65	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds)
66	    return sign * pos[idx]
67	
68	
69	def _float_to_fp4_nibble(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
70	    """Map FP4 float values to 4-bit nibble indices (0-15).
71	
72	    Encoding (FP4 E2M1):
73	      0→0, 1→0.5, 2→1.0, 3→1.5, 4→2.0, 5→3.0, 6→4.0, 7→6.0
74	      8→-0, 9→-0.5, 10→-1.0, ..., 15→-6.0
75	    """
76	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
77	    sign = (x < 0).to(torch.uint8)
78	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds).to(torch.uint8)
79	    return idx | (sign << 3)  # 0-7 positive, 8-15 negative
80	
81	
82	def pack_nvfp4(weight: torch.Tensor, group_size: int = FP4_GROUP_SIZE):
83	    """Pack a BF16 weight matrix into NVFP4 format.
84	
85	    Args:
86	        weight: (N, K) BF16 tensor (N = out_features, K = in_features)
87	        group_size: elements per FP8 scale group (must be 16 for NVFP4)
88	
89	    Returns:
90	        weight_packed:  (N, K//2) uint8    — two FP4 nibbles per byte
91	        weight_scale:   (N, K//group_size) float8_e4m3fn  — per-group FP8 scale
92	        weight_scale_2: scalar float32     — global scale for the FP8 scales
93	    """
94	    assert weight.ndim == 2, f"Expected 2D weight, got {weight.ndim}D"
95	    N, K = weight.shape
96	    assert K % group_size == 0, f"K={K} must be divisible by group_size={group_size}"
97	
98	    w = weight.float().cpu()
99	    # Reshape into groups: (N, K/G, G)
100	    w_g = w.reshape(N, K // group_size, group_size)
101	
102	    # Per-group scale = max(|w|) / 6.0  (FP4 max magnitude = 6.0)
103	    per_group_scale = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1).clamp(min=1e-8) / 6.0  # (N, K/G)
104	
105	    # Global FP32 scale: normalise per-group scales to fit in fp8_e4m3fn range
106	    fp8_max = 448.0  # float8_e4m3fn max
107	    global_scale_val = float(per_group_scale.amax().clamp(min=1e-8).item() / fp8_max)
108	
109	    # Encode per-group scales as FP8 (round-trip to get exact values used)
110	    scales_f32 = (per_group_scale / global_scale_val).clamp(-fp8_max, fp8_max)
111	    weight_scale_fp8 = scales_f32.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)  # (N, K/G)
112	
113	    # Actual per-group scale after FP8 rounding
114	    actual_scale = weight_scale_fp8.float() * global_scale_val  # (N, K/G)
115	    actual_scale_exp = actual_scale.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, group_size)  # (N, K/G, G)
116	
117	    # Scale weights, round to FP4 grid
118	    w_scaled = (w_g / actual_scale_exp).clamp(-6.0, 6.0)
119	    w_fp4 = _fp4_round(w_scaled.reshape(N, K))  # (N, K) float, values ∈ FP4 grid
120	
121	    # Encode each value as a 4-bit nibble index
122	    nibbles = _float_to_fp4_nibble(w_fp4)  # (N, K) uint8, range 0-15
123	
124	    # Pack: even column → low nibble, odd column → high nibble
125	    even = nibbles[:, 0::2]        # (N, K//2)
126	    odd  = nibbles[:, 1::2]        # (N, K//2)
127	    weight_packed = (even | (odd << 4)).to(torch.uint8)  # (N, K//2)
128	
129	    weight_scale_2 = torch.tensor(global_scale_val, dtype=torch.float32)
130	
131	    return weight_packed, weight_scale_fp8, weight_scale_2
132	
133
```

```
def add_nvfp4_tensors(
    tensors: dict,
    sglang_key: str,
    weight_bf16: torch.Tensor,
    num_logical_weights: int | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Pack weight and add the three NVFP4 tensors to the output dict."""
    packed, scale, scale2 = pack_nvfp4(weight_bf16)
    tensors[f"{sglang_key}.weight"]       = packed
    tensors[f"{sglang_key}.weight_scale"] = scale
    if num_logical_weights is not None:
        assert num_logical_weights > 0, f"invalid num_logical_weights={num_logical_weights}"
        scale2 = scale2.reshape(1).repeat(num_logical_weights)
        input_scale = torch.ones(num_logical_weights, dtype=torch.float32)
    else:
        input_scale = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32)
    tensors[f"{sglang_key}.weight_scale_2"] = scale2
    # input_scale is used by CUTLASS W4A4; not needed for Marlin W4A16
    # but add a dummy so the loader doesn't warn
    tensors[f"{sglang_key}.input_scale"] = input_scale
```

```
"""DFlash draft 构造 + SALA target 组件加载（embed/lm_head）。

把脚本里反复重复的"加 sys.path / load config / build draft / freeze 组件"逻辑统一收口。
"""

from typing import Optional, Tuple

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from transformers import AutoConfig

from dflash import DRAFT_CONFIG_PATH, SALA_PATH
from dflash.target import load_sala_hf_model
from dflash.vendor import DFlashDraftModel
from dflash.vocab import VocabSubset, build_subset_lm_head, load_vocab_subset


def build_draft(
    config_path: str = DRAFT_CONFIG_PATH,
    attention_backend: str = "sdpa",
    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
    device: str = "cuda",
) -> DFlashDraftModel:
    cfg = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(config_path)
    cfg._attn_implementation = attention_backend
    if not hasattr(cfg, "dflash_config") or cfg.dflash_config is None:
        cfg.dflash_config = {}
    draft = DFlashDraftModel(cfg).to(device).to(dtype)
    return draft


def load_target_components(
    path: str = SALA_PATH,
    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
    device: str = "cuda",
    vocab_subset: Optional[VocabSubset] = None,
) -> Tuple[nn.Module, nn.Module]:
    """加载 SALA embed_tokens / lm_head 并 freeze；丢弃完整 target。

    vocab_subset != None 时返回 (embed, subset_lm_head)，subset lm_head 是
    target lm_head 切出的 selected rows，shape (H, V_subset)。lm_head 输出维度
    从 V_full=73448 减到 V_subset=32K，GEMM FLOPs 减 ~56%。
    """
    full = load_sala_hf_model(path=path, torch_dtype=dtype, output_hidden_states=False, device=None)
    embed = full.get_input_embeddings().to(device).to(dtype)
    target_lm_head = full.get_output_embeddings()        # 暂时 keep on cpu/wherever
    embed.requires_grad_(False)

    if vocab_subset is None:
        lm_head = target_lm_head.to(device).to(dtype)
        lm_head.requires_grad_(False)
    else:
        lm_head = build_subset_lm_head(
            target_lm_head, vocab_subset.selected_ids, dtype=dtype, device=device,
        )
    del full, target_lm_head
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    return embed, lm_head


def report_draft(draft: DFlashDraftModel) -> str:
    cfg = draft.config
    n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in draft.parameters())
    return (
        f"DFlashDraftModel: layers={cfg.num_hidden_layers}, hidden={cfg.hidden_size}, "
        f"n_params={n_params/1e6:.1f}M, block_size={cfg.block_size}, "
        f"target_layer_ids={cfg.dflash_config.get('target_layer_ids')}, "
        f"mask_token_id={cfg.dflash_config.get('mask_token_id')}, "
        f"attn={cfg._attn_implementation}"
    )
```

```
"""DFlash 训练 step：cross-doc anchor 约束 + per-position metric。

specforge 上游 OnlineDFlashModel 把 forward + loss 揉在一起。我们在这里复用它的内部组件
（noise embed / position ids / loss decay weight），但加两件事：

1. **Segment-aware anchor sampling**：anchor 必须落在 "loss_mask=True 且 anchor..anchor+block_size-1
   全在同一 doc 内" 的位置，否则 label 就跨 segment 污染。
2. **Segment-aware attention mask**：context kv 不仅要 kv_idx < anchor_pos，还要
   document_ids[kv_idx] == anchor_doc。draft kv 同 block 仍可见（保证 block 内 anchor 同 doc 即可）。

attention 提供两条路径：
  - sdpa 路径：dense bool mask (B, 1, Q, KV)。等价完整支持，profile 后期主要是慢（M=Q×KV
    所有 block 都算）。
  - flex 路径：torch flex_attention BlockMask（128×128 块粒度），跳过 0-block。配合
    cross-doc 隔离 + ctx 因 anchor_pos 截断的 lower-triangular 部分，理论 sparsity > 75%。

返回 per-position breakdown（pos1_acc / mean_acc / block_accept_len）方便 eval table 展示。
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

try:
    from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import BlockMask, create_block_mask
    FLEX_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    FLEX_AVAILABLE = False
    BlockMask = None
    create_block_mask = None

try:
    from liger_kernel.transformers.fused_linear_cross_entropy import (
        LigerFusedLinearCrossEntropyLoss,
    )
    LIGER_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    LIGER_AVAILABLE = False
    LigerFusedLinearCrossEntropyLoss = None


@dataclass
class StepStats:
    loss: float
    mean_acc: float           # 全部有效 (k > 0) 位置上的 accuracy
    pos1_acc: float           # block 第 1 位（k=1）的 accuracy（first-token acceptance proxy）
    block_accept_len: float   # cumprod(correct[k=1..bs-1]).sum() / n_blocks，理论 max = block_size - 1


# ---------- segment-aware anchor 采样 ----------

def _safe_anchor_mask(
    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
    document_ids: torch.Tensor,
    block_size: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """位置 t 是 "安全" 的 iff 对每个 k ∈ [0, block_size):
        loss_mask[t+k] = True 且 document_ids[t+k] == document_ids[t]。
    含义：anchor 落在 t 时 label window [t..t+bs-1] 全在同 doc 的有效 token 内。

    参考 eagle/training/sala_draft/packing.py:mask_segment_tail，逻辑等价。
    """
    B, T = loss_mask.shape
    out = loss_mask.bool().clone()
    for k in range(1, block_size):
        valid = T - k
        if valid > 0:
            same_loss = loss_mask[:, k:k + valid].bool()
            same_doc = document_ids[:, :valid] == document_ids[:, k:k + valid]
            out[:, :valid] = out[:, :valid] & same_loss & same_doc
        # 边界 [T-k, T) 必然不安全
        if valid < T:
            out[:, max(valid, 0):T] = False
    return out
```

```
139	class _NVFP4LinearFn(torch.autograd.Function):
140	    """Forward: NVFP4 GEMM (true 4-bit). Backward: bf16 STE.
141	
142	    NVFP4 official scale convention applied so input_global_scale * input fits
143	    the joint FP4*E4M3 dynamic range. ``alpha = 1 / (gs_x * gs_w)`` descales
144	    the output back to the original magnitude. Without this, weights with
145	    small amax (e.g. ~0.01 after init_mlp_from_target) trigger e4m3 underflow
146	    and the GEMM produces NaN on entire blocks.
147	
148	    STE backward: forward uses the FP4-quantized weight, but the gradient
149	    w.r.t. the master bf16 weight is the standard linear gradient
150	    (grad_w = grad_out.T @ x), identical to the legacy fake-quant STE.
151	    """
```

```
def fp4_quant_freeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
    """Pre-quantize every FP4QATLinear weight so multi-step forwards reuse it.

    NVFP4_FORWARD=1: caches packed (wq, wsf, w_gs) — weight quantize cost is
    paid once per optimizer step instead of TTT_STEPS times.
    NVFP4_FORWARD=0: caches fake-STE quantized weight (bf16 tensor).
    """
    if not FP4_QAT:
        return
    for m in model.modules():
        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear) and m.training:
            if getattr(m, "_fp4_skip", False):
                continue
            if NVFP4_FORWARD:
                with torch.no_grad():
                    w_gs = _compute_global_scale(m.weight)
                    wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(m.weight, w_gs)
                m._fp4_qw_packed = wq
                m._fp4_qw_sf = wsf
                m._fp4_w_gs = w_gs
            else:
                m._fp4_qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(m.weight)


def fp4_quant_unfreeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
    """Clear the per-step quantized-weight cache after backward."""
    for m in model.modules():
        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear):
            m._fp4_qw = None
            m._fp4_qw_packed = None
            m._fp4_qw_sf = None
            m._fp4_w_gs = None
```

## EAGLE QAT NVFP4 Forward 路径完整分析

我已经系统地查清了 eagle 仓库中 NVFP4 QAT 的实现。下面是按优先级给出的关键发现：

### 1. **QAT Forward 实现在哪里 + 关键代码**

**核心文件**：
- `/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/core/fp4_quant.py` (241 行) — 包含所有 QAT 逻辑
- `/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/core/arch.py` — 架构定义，所有 Linear 层使用 `FP4QATLinear`
- `/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/training/sala_draft/train.py` — 训练脚本，调用 `fp4_quant_freeze/unfreeze`
- `/user_4813494d/openbmb/eagle/legacy/v2_v3/convert_to_sglang.py` — 推理转换脚本，将 bf16 权重转 NVFP4 格式

**Fake-Quant 核心流程**（eagle/core/fp4_quant.py:186-206）：

```python
# FP4QATLinear.forward() — 训练时的 fake-quant
def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if not (self.training and FP4_QAT):
        return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)  # eval: 纯 bf16
    
    if NVFP4_FORWARD:  # True 4-bit GEMM 路径 (sm_120, 默认)
        w_gs = _compute_global_scale(self.weight)  # 行 197
        wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(self.weight, w_gs)  # sgl-kernel 量化
        out = _NVFP4LinearFn.apply(x, self.weight, wq, wsf, w_gs)  # 行 199: GEMM
        return out + self.bias if self.bias else out
    else:  # 遗留 fake-STE 路径
        qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(self.weight)  # 行 205
        return F.linear(x, qw, self.bias)
```

**真 4-bit GEMM forward** (_NVFP4LinearFn, 行 139-166)：

```python
def forward(ctx, x, weight_bf16, wq, wsf, w_gs):
    x_gs = _compute_global_scale(x2d)  # 行 156: 逐张量输入 scale
    xq, xsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(x2d, x_gs)  # 行 157: 激活也量化
    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).contiguous()  # 行 158: 反缩放因子
    out2d = _fi_mm_fp4(
        xq, wq.T, xsf, wsf.T, alpha,
        out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        block_size=16, use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass",  # 行 159-162
    )
    ctx.save_for_backward(x, weight_bf16)  # 保存原始 bf16 weight 用于梯度
    return out2d.view(out_shape)
```

### 2. **量化粒度 + Scale 算法**

| 维度 | 配置 |
|------|------|
| **Weight 量化粒度** | Per-group-of-16（16 权重共 1 个 FP8 scale）|
| **Weight scale 计算** | `scale = max(\|w_group\|) / 6.0`（FP4 E2M1 max = 6.0）|
| **Input 量化粒度** | Per-tensor（整个输入共 1 个 global scale）|
| **Input scale 算法** | `x_gs = 2688 / amax(x)`（2688 = E4M3_max × FP4_max = 448 × 6）|
| **Scale 类型** | **Not learnable** — 由 amax 动态计算，每个 forward 重新算 |
| **输出反缩放** | `alpha = 1 / (x_gs × w_gs)` 映射回原始大小（防止 e4m3 underflow）|

### 3. **STE Backward 实现**

```python
# _NVFP4LinearFn.backward (行 168-175)
def backward(ctx, grad_out):
    x, w = ctx.saved_tensors  # 保存的是原始 bf16 weight，不是 fp4
    grad_x = (grad_out_2d @ w).view_as(x)
    grad_w = grad_out_2d.t() @ x_2d  # 标准线性梯度
    return grad_x, grad_w, None, None, None
```

**关键点**：
- **Forward 用 FP4 权重** (`wq`)，**Backward 用原始 bf16 权重** (`weight_bf16`)
- **梯度流** = 标准 Linear 梯度，等同于 fake-quant STE：`(grad - grad.detach()) + fake_quant(grad).detach()` 的隐含形式
- **W4 only，无激活量化**：激活虽然在 GEMM 里量化，但 input_scale 不可训练，仅用于数值稳定性

### 4. **训练流程**

**单阶段 NVFP4 直接训练**（eagle/training/sala_draft/train.py）：

```python
# 行 643-746: 初始化
if FP4_QAT:
    v3train.init_mlp_from_target(model)  # 从 target 初始化 MLP (warm-start)
    # 所有 FP4QATLinear 从 target bf16 权重开始，不是随机初始化

# 行 318: 每个 TTT step 前冻结量化
v3train.fp4_quant_freeze(self)  # 缓存 (wq, wsf, w_gs) 3 步复用

# 行 446: backward 后解冻量化缓存
v3train.fp4_quant_unfreeze(self)  # 清除缓存，下一 step 重新量化
```

**流程类型**：
- ✅ **从头 NVFP4 训练**（不是两阶段）
- ✅ **Warm-start 机制**：MLP 权重初始化自 target bf16，减少量化误差
- ✅ **每步量化一次**：`fp4_quant_freeze()` 缓存 packed (wq, wsf, w_gs) 以支持 TTT 3 步复用
- ✅ **Checkpoint 保存 bf16**：`state_dict()` 存的是原始浮点权重，推理时转 NVFP4

### 5. **推理转换路径**

**Checkpoint → SGLang NVFP4 格式** (eagle/legacy/v2_v3/convert_to_sglang.py:82-132, 行 134-154)：

```python
def pack_nvfp4(weight: torch.Tensor, group_size=16):
    """BF16 → NVFP4 format (无量化，因为 QAT 权重已在 FP4 grid 上)"""
    w_g = weight.reshape(N, K//16, 16)
    per_group_scale = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1) / 6.0  # 行 103
    global_scale = per_group_scale.amax() / 448.0   # 行 107: fp8_e4m3fn 范围归一化
    
    # 编码：weight_packed (uint8, 2 nibbles/byte) + weight_scale (fp8) + weight_scale_2 (f32)
    return weight_packed, weight_scale_fp8, global_scale_val
```

**关键输出 3-tuple**：
- `weight` (uint8): 4-bit nibble 打包
- `weight_scale` (float8_e4m3fn): per-group scale
- `weight_scale_2` (float32): 全局 scale

这 3 个张量直接被 SGLang 的 Marlin W4A16 / CUTLASS 后端读取，与推理时 NVFP4 GEMM 配置一致。

### 6. **W4-only 确认**

✅ **权重量化**：NVFP4 4-bit (per-group-of-16, grid: FP4 E2M1)  
✅ **激活量化**：per-tensor FP4 E4M3，但 scale **不可训练**（动态计算 `x_gs = 2688/amax`）  
✅ **量化形式**：推理转 SGLang 时标注为 `quantization="modelopt_fp4"` + Marlin dispatch（W4A16）  
✅ **非 W4A4**：input_scale 在推理转换时被设为 dummy `ones(1)` 或重复数组，注释明确说"不用于 Marlin"（行 151）

### 7. **与 sm_120 inference 的对齐**

| 维度 | QAT | Inference |
|------|-----|-----------|
| **Group size** | 16（per-group scale） | 16（modelopt NVFP4 标准） |
| **Weight scale 算法** | `max(\|w\|) / 6.0` | 一致（pack_nvfp4） |
| **Global scale** | `2688 / amax(x)`（per-tensor，动态） | `weight_scale_2` 存储（转换时计算） |
| **GEMM backend** | flashinfer.mm_fp4(use_nvfp4=True, cutlass) | SGLang Marlin W4A16 |
| **Tensor layout** | 隐式（sgl_kernel 打包） | uint8 nibble + fp8 + f32 3-tuple |

**对齐状态**：✅ 完全对齐。QAT 时的量化决策（per-group amax、global scale、FP4 grid）在推理转换时重新应用，确保权重落在同一 FP4 grid。

---

## 8. **DFlash 复用可行性分析**

DFlash 当前 **不支持 NVFP4 QAT**，原因：

1. **DFlash 没有 Linear 量化**：`dflash/model.py` 使用纯 `nn.Linear`，无 `FP4QATLinear` 替换
2. **DFlash 权重规模不同**：Draft model 通常更小（几百 M），NVFP4 4-bit 省显存收益有限
3. **Training loop 独立**：DFlash 的 `training.py` 无 `fp4_quant_freeze/unfreeze` 调用

**可移植的部分**：
- ✅ `FP4QATLinear` 类本身（与架构无关）
- ✅ `_NVFP4LinearFn` + `fp4_quant_freeze/unfreeze` 工具函数
- ✅ Scale 计算逻辑（`_compute_global_scale`, `_sgl_scaled_fp4_quant` 外部依赖）

**DFlash 集成步骤**（若需要）：
1. 将 eagle/core/ 中的 `fp4_quant.py` 复制到 dflash/core/
2. 替换 DFlash Linear：`nn.Linear` → `FP4QATLinear`（需要导入 sgl-kernel + flashinfer）
3. 在 DFlash training loop 中插入 `fp4_quant_freeze/unfreeze`
4. 更新 checkpoint 转换器（参考 eagle/legacy/v2_v3/convert_to_sglang.py）

**关键差异**：
- Eagle 依赖 sgl-kernel + flashinfer（通过环境变量可降级到 fake-STE）
- DFlash 目前无这些依赖，集成需要额外 pip install 或容器配置

```
37	class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
38	    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float = RMS_NORM_EPS):
39	        super().__init__()
40	        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))
41	        self.eps = eps

43	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
44	        norm = x.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True).add(self.eps).rsqrt()
45	        return (x * norm).to(x.dtype) * self.weight

50	def build_rope_cache(head_dim: int, max_seq: int, theta: float = ROPE_THETA):
51	    """Returns (cos, sin) of shape (max_seq, head_dim/2), fp32."""
52	    inv_freq = 1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / head_dim))
53	    t = torch.arange(max_seq, dtype=torch.float32)
54	    freqs = torch.outer(t, inv_freq)   # (max_seq, head_dim/2)
55	    return torch.cos(freqs), torch.sin(freqs)
56

58	def apply_rotary_pos_emb(x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor,
59	                         position_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
60	    """Apply neox-style RoPE to x: (B, num_heads, S, head_dim).
61	
62	    cos/sin: (max_seq, head_dim/2). position_ids: (B, S).
63	    """
64	    cos_pos = cos[position_ids].unsqueeze(1)   # (B, 1, S, head_dim/2)
65	    sin_pos = sin[position_ids].unsqueeze(1)
66	    x1 = x[..., :x.shape[-1] // 2]
67	    x2 = x[..., x.shape[-1] // 2:]
68	    return torch.cat([x1 * cos_pos - x2 * sin_pos,
69	                      x2 * cos_pos + x1 * sin_pos], dim=-1)

74	class Eagle3Attention(nn.Module):
75	    """EAGLE-3 attention with list-based KV cache across TTT steps + RoPE.
76	
77	    Step 0: SDPA. Single-doc → flash via ``is_causal=True``. Multi-doc
78	    (packed) → matrix path via ``packed_attn_mask``.
79	
80	    Step k>0: cache_k[0] cross-position + cache_k[i>=1] self-position. Single
81	    softmax over (S + n_extra) keys; ``n_extra`` entries are diagonal — q[p]
82	    only sees cache_k[i][p].
83	    """
84	    def __init__(self, rope_max_seq: int = 18496, rope_theta: float = ROPE_THETA):
85	        super().__init__()
86	        self.num_heads = NUM_HEADS
87	        self.num_kv_heads = NUM_KV_HEADS
88	        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
89	        self.num_kv_groups = NUM_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS
90	
91	        qkv_in = HIDDEN_SIZE * 2  # cat(embed, hidden)
92	        self.q_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
93	        self.k_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
94	        self.v_proj = FP4QATLinear(qkv_in, NUM_KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, bias=False)
95	        self.o_proj = FP4QATLinear(NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False)
96	
97	        cos, sin = build_rope_cache(HEAD_DIM, max_seq=rope_max_seq, theta=rope_theta)
98	        self.register_buffer("rope_cos", cos, persistent=False)
99	        self.register_buffer("rope_sin", sin, persistent=False)
100	
101	    def forward(self, hidden_cat, cache_k_list, cache_v_list, causal_mask=None,
102	                position_ids=None, packed_attn_mask=None):
103	        """
104	        hidden_cat: (B, S, 2*H)
105	        cache_k_list, cache_v_list: lists of (B, num_heads, S, head_dim) from prior TTT steps, or None
106	        causal_mask: (1, 1, S, S) additive mask used only in step k>0 single-doc manual path
107	        packed_attn_mask: (B, 1, S, S) bool (True=attend) or additive float
108	            cross-doc+causal mask. When set, step 0 SDPA uses this instead of
109	            is_causal flash. Step k>0 uses it in place of causal_mask for
110	            cache_k[0]. Pass None for single-doc training to keep the flash path.
111	        position_ids: (B, S) — positions for RoPE; offset by cache length for multi-step
112	        Returns: output (B, S, H), new_cache_k_list, new_cache_v_list
113	        """
114	        B, S, _ = hidden_cat.shape
115	
116	        q = self.q_proj(hidden_cat).view(B, S, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
117	        k = self.k_proj(hidden_cat).view(B, S, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
118	        v = self.v_proj(hidden_cat).view(B, S, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
119	
120	        if position_ids is None:
121	            position_ids = torch.arange(S, device=hidden_cat.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1)
122	        q = apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, self.rope_cos, self.rope_sin, position_ids)
123	        k = apply_rotary_pos_emb(k, self.rope_cos, self.rope_sin, position_ids)
124	
125	        if self.num_kv_groups > 1:
126	            k = k.repeat_interleave(self.num_kv_groups, dim=1)
127	            v = v.repeat_interleave(self.num_kv_groups, dim=1)
128	
129	        if cache_k_list is None:
130	            local_cache_k = []
131	            local_cache_v = []
132	        else:
133	            local_cache_k = list(cache_k_list)
134	            local_cache_v = list(cache_v_list)
135	
136	        local_cache_k.append(k)
137	        local_cache_v.append(v)
138	        n_cached = len(local_cache_k)
139	        inv_sqrt_d = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
140	
141	        if n_cached == 1:
142	            if packed_attn_mask is None:
143	                attn_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
144	                    q, local_cache_k[0], local_cache_v[0], is_causal=True
145	                )
146	            else:
147	                attn_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
148	                    q, local_cache_k[0], local_cache_v[0], attn_mask=packed_attn_mask
149	                )
150	        else:
151	            k0 = local_cache_k[0]
152	            v0 = local_cache_v[0]
153	
154	            attn_w0 = torch.matmul(q, k0.transpose(-2, -1)) * inv_sqrt_d
155	            mask_for_cache0 = packed_attn_mask if packed_attn_mask is not None else causal_mask
156	            if mask_for_cache0 is not None:
157	                if mask_for_cache0.dtype == torch.bool:
158	                    attn_w0 = attn_w0.masked_fill(~mask_for_cache0, float("-inf"))
159	                else:
160	                    attn_w0 = attn_w0 + mask_for_cache0
161	
162	            n_extra = n_cached - 1
163	            if n_extra > 0:
164	                # (B, H, n_extra, S, D) → (B, H, S, n_extra, D)
165	                extra_k = torch.stack(local_cache_k[1:], dim=2).transpose(2, 3)
166	                extra_v = torch.stack(local_cache_v[1:], dim=2).transpose(2, 3)
167	                extra_w = (q.unsqueeze(3) * extra_k).sum(dim=-1) * inv_sqrt_d
168	                attn_w = torch.cat([attn_w0, extra_w], dim=-1)
169	            else:
170	                attn_w = attn_w0
171	                extra_v = None
172	
173	            # bf16 softmax: input/output stay in q.dtype (bf16). Avoids
174	            # materializing the (B, H, S, S+n_extra) tensor in fp32 — that
175	            # was the dominant copy_ + mul source on long sequences (S=4095).
176	            # Numerical stability over a 4097-key reduction in bf16 holds
177	            # because the kernel still applies the standard max-shift before
178	            # exp; only the sum + division accumulate in bf16.
179	            attn_w = F.softmax(attn_w, dim=-1)
180	
181	            attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_w[..., :S], v0)
182	            if n_extra > 0:
183	                extra_w_p = attn_w[..., S:]   # (B, H, S, n_extra)
184	                attn_output = attn_output + (extra_w_p.unsqueeze(-1) * extra_v).sum(dim=3)
185	
186	        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, -1)
187	        return self.o_proj(attn_output), local_cache_k, local_cache_v
188	
189	
190	# ── MLP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
191	
192	class Eagle3MLP(nn.Module):
193	    def __init__(self):
194	        super().__init__()
195	        self.gate_proj = FP4QATLinear(HIDDEN_SIZE, INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, bias=False)
196	        self.up_proj = FP4QATLinear(HIDDEN_SIZE, INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, bias=False)
197	        self.down_proj = FP4QATLinear(INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, HIDDEN_SIZE, bias=False)
198	
199	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
200	        return self.down_proj(F.silu(self.gate_proj(x)) * self.up_proj(x))
201	
202	
203	# ── Decoder Layer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
204	
205	class Eagle3DecoderLayer(nn.Module):
206	    def __init__(self, rope_max_seq: int = 18496, rope_theta: float = ROPE_THETA):
207	        super().__init__()
208	        self.hidden_norm = RMSNorm(HIDDEN_SIZE, RMS_NORM_EPS)
209	        self.input_emb_norm = RMSNorm(HIDDEN_SIZE, RMS_NORM_EPS)
210	        self.self_attn = Eagle3Attention(rope_max_seq=rope_max_seq, rope_theta=rope_theta)
211	        self.post_attention_layernorm = RMSNorm(HIDDEN_SIZE, RMS_NORM_EPS)
212	        self.mlp = Eagle3MLP()
213	
214	    def forward(self, input_emb, hidden_states, cache_k_list=None, cache_v_list=None,
215	                causal_mask=None, position_ids=None, packed_attn_mask=None):
216	        residual = hidden_states
217	
218	        normed_emb = self.input_emb_norm(input_emb)
219	        normed_hidden = self.hidden_norm(hidden_states)
220	        hidden_cat = torch.cat([normed_emb, normed_hidden], dim=-1)
221	
222	        attn_out, cache_k_list, cache_v_list = self.self_attn(
223	            hidden_cat, cache_k_list, cache_v_list,
224	            causal_mask=causal_mask, position_ids=position_ids,
225	            packed_attn_mask=packed_attn_mask,
226	        )
227	        hidden_states = residual + attn_out
228	
229	        residual = hidden_states
230	        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
231	        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
232	        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
233	
234	        return hidden_states, cache_k_list, cache_v_list
235
```

```
1	"""FP4 quantization for EAGLE-3 draft training.
2	
3	Two forward modes share one ``FP4QATLinear`` interface:
4	
5	  * **NVFP4_FORWARD=1** (default when sgl-kernel + flashinfer present, sm_120):
6	    Real 4-bit GEMM via ``flashinfer.mm_fp4(use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass")``.
7	    Backward is bf16 STE — gradients flow through the master bf16 weight as if
8	    fake-quant, so optimizer behaviour is unchanged.
9	
10	  * **NVFP4_FORWARD=0**: Legacy fake-STE — bf16 GEMM with FP4-rounded weight
11	    (``_FP4QuantSTE``). Identical math, ~5x slower.
12	
13	Public API:
14	    FP4QATLinear           drop-in replacement for nn.Linear
15	    fp4_quant_freeze(model)   pre-quantize weights once per training step so
16	                              multi-step (TTT) forwards reuse the cached FP4
17	                              representation
18	    fp4_quant_unfreeze(model) clear cache (called at end of forward)
19	
20	Toggles (env):
21	    EAGLE_NVFP4_FORWARD=0/1   (default 1)  switch between true 4-bit and fake STE
22	    EAGLE_NVFP4_EXCLUDE_LM_HEAD=0/1 (default 1)  skip lm_head; vocab-projection
23	                              quant-noise leaks into every token's softmax
24	    SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE     path to flashinfer autotune JSON (loaded lazily)
25	
26	Convention (per ``sgl-kernel/tests/test_fp4_gemm.py``):
27	    gs = (E4M3_max * FP4_max) / amax = 2688 / amax    (multiplied onto input)
28	    alpha = 1 / (gs_a * gs_b)                          (descales output)
29	"""

31	
32	import os
33	
34	import torch

41	FP4_QAT = True
42	FP4_GROUP_SIZE = 16  # NVFP4 group size (16 weights share one FP8 scale)
43	
44	# E4M3_max * FP4_max — joint upper bound of NVFP4's representable range.
45	_FP4_E4M3_E2M1_PRODUCT = 448.0 * 6.0   # = 2688
46	
47	# FP4 E2M1 positive values and their rounding boundaries (for STE round path)
48	_FP4_POS = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
49	_FP4_BOUNDS = torch.tensor([0.25, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0])

73

75	    (4095 / 16380) — but loading is harmless and shares the inference table.
76	    """

78	    if _NVFP4_AUTOTUNE_LOADED or not _NVFP4_FORWARD_AVAILABLE:

95	# ── STE round (legacy fake-quant path) ────────────────────────────────────
96	
97	def _fp4_round(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
98	    """Round each element to the nearest FP4 E2M1 representable value.
99	
100	    Input: any float tensor (preferably already in [-6, 6]).
101	    Output: same dtype, values in {0, ±0.5, ±1, ±1.5, ±2, ±3, ±4, ±6}.
102	    """
103	    pos = _FP4_POS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
104	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
105	    sign = x.sign()
106	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds)
107	    return sign * pos[idx]
108	
109	
110	class _FP4QuantSTE(torch.autograd.Function):
111	    """Fake-quantize weight to FP4 E2M1 in forward; straight-through in backward.
112	
113	    Per-group-of-16 scaling: ``scale = max(|w_group|) / 6.0``. Stays in the
114	    weight's native dtype (bf16); only the per-group scale (1 value per 16
115	    weights) goes through fp32 for clamp stability.
116	    """
117	    @staticmethod
118	    def forward(ctx, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
119	        N, K = weight.shape
120	        w_g = weight.reshape(N, K // FP4_GROUP_SIZE, FP4_GROUP_SIZE)
121	        abs_max = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
122	        scale = (abs_max.float().clamp(min=1e-8) / 6.0).to(weight.dtype)
123	        w_q = _fp4_round(w_g / scale) * scale
124	        return w_q.reshape(N, K)
125	
126	    @staticmethod
127	    def backward(ctx, grad: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
128	        return grad  # STE
129	
130	
131	# ── True 4-bit forward path (NVFP4 cutlass) ───────────────────────────────
132	
133	def _compute_global_scale(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
134	    """Per-tensor input_global_scale matching the NVFP4 reference."""
135	    amax = t.detach().abs().amax().to(torch.float32).clamp(min=1e-6)
136	    return (_FP4_E4M3_E2M1_PRODUCT / amax).view(1)
137	
138	
139	class _NVFP4LinearFn(torch.autograd.Function):
140	    """Forward: NVFP4 GEMM (true 4-bit). Backward: bf16 STE.
141	
142	    NVFP4 official scale convention applied so input_global_scale * input fits
143	    the joint FP4*E4M3 dynamic range. ``alpha = 1 / (gs_x * gs_w)`` descales
144	    the output back to the original magnitude. Without this, weights with
145	    small amax (e.g. ~0.01 after init_mlp_from_target) trigger e4m3 underflow
146	    and the GEMM produces NaN on entire blocks.
147	
148	    STE backward: forward uses the FP4-quantized weight, but the gradient
149	    w.r.t. the master bf16 weight is the standard linear gradient
150	    (grad_w = grad_out.T @ x), identical to the legacy fake-quant STE.
151	    """
152	    @staticmethod
153	    def forward(ctx, x, weight_bf16, wq, wsf, w_gs):
154	        _maybe_load_nvfp4_autotune()
155	        x2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
156	        x_gs = _compute_global_scale(x2d)
157	        xq, xsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(x2d, x_gs)
158	        alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).contiguous()
159	        out2d = _fi_mm_fp4(
160	            xq, wq.T, xsf, wsf.T, alpha,
161	            out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
162	            block_size=16, use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass",
163	        )
164	        out_shape = list(x.shape[:-1]) + [out2d.shape[-1]]
165	        ctx.save_for_backward(x, weight_bf16)
166	        return out2d.view(out_shape)
167	
168	    @staticmethod
169	    def backward(ctx, grad_out):
170	        x, w = ctx.saved_tensors
171	        grad_out_2d = grad_out.reshape(-1, grad_out.shape[-1])
172	        x_2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
173	        grad_x = (grad_out_2d @ w).view_as(x)
174	        grad_w = grad_out_2d.t() @ x_2d
175	        return grad_x, grad_w, None, None, None
176	
177	
178	# ── Linear wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
179	
180	class FP4QATLinear(nn.Linear):
181	    """nn.Linear with FP4 fake-quantization on weights during training.
182	
183	    Eval / FP4_QAT=False / ``_fp4_skip=True``: plain bf16 ``F.linear`` so the
184	    final RTN export matches inference exactly.
185	    """
186	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
187	        if not (self.training and FP4_QAT):
188	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
189	        if getattr(self, "_fp4_skip", False):
190	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
191	
192	        if NVFP4_FORWARD:
193	            wq = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_packed", None)
194	            wsf = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_sf", None)
195	            w_gs = getattr(self, "_fp4_w_gs", None)
196	            if wq is None:
197	                w_gs = _compute_global_scale(self.weight)
198	                wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(self.weight, w_gs)
199	            out = _NVFP4LinearFn.apply(x, self.weight, wq, wsf, w_gs)
200	            return out if self.bias is None else (out + self.bias)
201	
202	        # Legacy fake-STE (bf16 GEMM, FP4-rounded weight).
203	        qw = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw", None)
204	        if qw is None:
205	            qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(self.weight)
206	        return F.linear(x, qw, self.bias)
207

209	def fp4_quant_freeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
210	    """Pre-quantize every FP4QATLinear weight so multi-step forwards reuse it.
211	
212	    NVFP4_FORWARD=1: caches packed (wq, wsf, w_gs) — weight quantize cost is
213	    paid once per optimizer step instead of TTT_STEPS times.
214	    NVFP4_FORWARD=0: caches fake-STE quantized weight (bf16 tensor).
215	    """
216	    if not FP4_QAT:
217	        return
218	    for m in model.modules():
219	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear) and m.training:
220	            if getattr(m, "_fp4_skip", False):
221	                continue
222	            if NVFP4_FORWARD:
223	                with torch.no_grad():
224	                    w_gs = _compute_global_scale(m.weight)
225	                    wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(m.weight, w_gs)
226	                m._fp4_qw_packed = wq
227	                m._fp4_qw_sf = wsf
228	                m._fp4_w_gs = w_gs
229	            else:
230	                m._fp4_qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(m.weight)
231	
232	
233	def fp4_quant_unfreeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
234	    """Clear the per-step quantized-weight cache after backward."""
235	    for m in model.modules():
236	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear):
237	            m._fp4_qw = None
238	            m._fp4_qw_packed = None
239	            m._fp4_qw_sf = None
240	            m._fp4_w_gs = None
```

```
23	def sample(logits: torch.Tensor, temperature: float = 0.0) -> torch.Tensor:
24	    if temperature < 1e-5:
25	        return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
26	    bsz, seq_len, vocab_size = logits.shape
27	    logits = logits.view(-1, vocab_size)
28	    logits = logits / temperature
29	    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
30	    return torch.multinomial(probs, num_samples=1).view(bsz, seq_len)

33	def apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin, position_ids=None, unsqueeze_dim=1):
34	    cos = cos.unsqueeze(unsqueeze_dim)
35	    sin = sin.unsqueeze(unsqueeze_dim)
36	    q_len = q.size(-2)
37	    q_embed = (q * cos[..., -q_len:, :]) + (rotate_half(q) * sin[..., -q_len:, :])
38	    k_embed = (k * cos) + (rotate_half(k) * sin)
39	    return q_embed, k_embed

42	class Qwen3DFlashAttention(nn.Module):
43	    """Multi-headed attention from 'Attention Is All You Need' paper"""
44	
45	    def __init__(self, config: Qwen3Config, layer_idx: int):
46	        super().__init__()
47	        self.config = config
48	        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
49	        self.head_dim = getattr(
50	            config, "head_dim", config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads
51	        )
52	        self.num_key_value_groups = (
53	            config.num_attention_heads // config.num_key_value_heads
54	        )
55	        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
56	        self.attention_dropout = config.attention_dropout
57	        self.is_causal = False
58	        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(
59	            config.hidden_size,
60	            config.num_attention_heads * self.head_dim,
61	            bias=config.attention_bias,
62	        )
63	        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(
64	            config.hidden_size,
65	            config.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim,
66	            bias=config.attention_bias,
67	        )
68	        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(
69	            config.hidden_size,
70	            config.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim,
71	            bias=config.attention_bias,
72	        )
73	        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(
74	            config.num_attention_heads * self.head_dim,
75	            config.hidden_size,
76	            bias=config.attention_bias,
77	        )
78	        self.q_norm = Qwen3RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
79	        self.k_norm = Qwen3RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
80	        self.sliding_window = (
81	            config.sliding_window
82	            if config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "sliding_attention"
83	            else None
84	        )

86	    def forward(
87	        self,
88	        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
89	        target_hidden: torch.Tensor,
90	        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
91	        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor],
92	        past_key_values: Optional[Cache] = None,
93	        cache_position: Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None,
94	        **kwargs: Unpack[FlashAttentionKwargs],
95	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
96	        bsz, q_len = hidden_states.shape[:-1]
97	        ctx_len = target_hidden.shape[1]
98	        q = self.q_proj(hidden_states)
99	        q = q.view(bsz, q_len, -1, self.head_dim)
100	        q = self.q_norm(q).transpose(1, 2)
101	        k_ctx = self.k_proj(target_hidden)
102	        k_noise = self.k_proj(hidden_states)
103	        v_ctx = self.v_proj(target_hidden)
104	        v_noise = self.v_proj(hidden_states)
105	        k = torch.cat([k_ctx, k_noise], dim=1).view(
106	            bsz, ctx_len + q_len, -1, self.head_dim
107	        )
108	        v = torch.cat([v_ctx, v_noise], dim=1).view(
109	            bsz, ctx_len + q_len, -1, self.head_dim
110	        )
111	        k = self.k_norm(k).transpose(1, 2)
112	        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
113	        cos, sin = position_embeddings
114	        q, k = apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin)
115	        if past_key_values is not None:
116	            cache_kwargs = {"sin": sin, "cos": cos, "cache_position": cache_position}
117	            k, v = past_key_values.update(k, v, self.layer_idx, cache_kwargs)
118	        attn_fn: Callable = eager_attention_forward
119	        if self.config._attn_implementation != "eager":
120	            attn_fn = ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS[self.config._attn_implementation]
121	        attn_output, attn_weights = attn_fn(
122	            self,
123	            q,
124	            k,
125	            v,
126	            attention_mask,

128	            scaling=self.scaling,

132	        attn_output = attn_output.reshape(bsz, q_len, -1)
133	        attn_output = self.o_proj(attn_output)
134	        return attn_output, attn_weights

162	    ) -> Tuple[
163	        torch.FloatTensor, Optional[Tuple[torch.FloatTensor, torch.FloatTensor]]
164	    ]:
165	        residual = hidden_states
166	        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
167	        hidden_states = self.self_attn(

179	        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
180	        residual = hidden_states
181	        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
182	        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
183	        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states

187	def build_target_layer_ids(num_target_layers: int, num_draft_layers: int):
188	    if num_draft_layers == 1:
189	        return [(num_target_layers // 2)]
190	    start = 1
191	    end = num_target_layers - 3
192	    span = end - start
193	    target_layer_ids = [
194	        int(round(start + (i * span) / (num_draft_layers - 1)))
195	        for i in range(num_draft_layers)
196	    ]
197	    return target_layer_ids

200	def extract_context_feature(
201	    hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor],
202	    layer_ids: Optional[list[int]],
203	) -> torch.Tensor:
204	    offset = 1
205	    selected_states = []
206	    for layer_id in layer_ids:
207	        selected_states.append(hidden_states[layer_id + offset])
208	    target_hidden = torch.cat(selected_states, dim=-1)
209	    return target_hidden

216	    def __init__(self, config) -> None:
217	        super().__init__(config)
218	        self.config = config
219	        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
220	            [
221	                Qwen3DFlashDecoderLayer(config, layer_idx)
222	                for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
223	            ]
224	        )
225	        dflash_config = getattr(config, "dflash_config", {}) or {}
226	        self.target_layer_ids = dflash_config.get(

229	        )

231	        self.rotary_emb = Qwen3RotaryEmbedding(config)
232	        self.fc = nn.Linear(
233	            len(self.target_layer_ids) * config.hidden_size,
234	            config.hidden_size,
235	            bias=False,
236	        )
237	        self.hidden_norm = Qwen3RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
238	        self.block_size = config.block_size
239	        self.mask_token_id = dflash_config.get("mask_token_id", None)
240	        self.post_init()

242	    def forward(
243	        self,
244	        position_ids: torch.LongTensor,
245	        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
246	        noise_embedding: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
247	        target_hidden: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
248	        past_key_values: Optional[Cache] = None,
249	        use_cache: bool = False,

251	    ) -> CausalLMOutputWithPast:
252	        hidden_states = noise_embedding
253	        target_hidden = self.hidden_norm(self.fc(target_hidden))
254	        position_embeddings = self.rotary_emb(hidden_states, position_ids)
255	        for layer in self.layers:
256	            hidden_states = layer(
257	                hidden_states=hidden_states,
258	                target_hidden=target_hidden,
259	                attention_mask=attention_mask,
260	                position_ids=position_ids,
261	                past_key_value=past_key_values,

268	    @torch.inference_mode()
269	    def spec_generate(
270	        self,
271	        target: nn.Module,
272	        input_ids: torch.LongTensor,
273	        max_new_tokens: int,
274	        stop_token_ids: list[int],
275	        temperature: float,
276	    ):
277	        self.eval()
278	        num_input_tokens = input_ids.shape[1]
279	        max_length = num_input_tokens + max_new_tokens
280	
281	        block_size = self.block_size
282	        output_ids = torch.full(
283	            (1, max_length + block_size),
284	            self.mask_token_id,
285	            dtype=torch.long,
286	            device=target.device,
287	        )
288	        position_ids = torch.arange(
289	            output_ids.shape[1], device=target.device
290	        ).unsqueeze(0)
291	
292	        past_key_values_target = DynamicCache()
293	        past_key_values_draft = DynamicCache()
294	
295	        # Prefill stage
296	        output = target(
297	            input_ids,
298	            position_ids=position_ids[:, :num_input_tokens],
299	            past_key_values=past_key_values_target,
300	            use_cache=True,
301	            logits_to_keep=1,
302	            output_hidden_states=True,
303	        )
304	
305	        output_ids[:, :num_input_tokens] = input_ids
306	        output_ids[:, num_input_tokens : num_input_tokens + 1] = sample(
307	            output.logits, temperature
308	        )
309	        target_hidden = extract_context_feature(
310	            output.hidden_states, self.target_layer_ids
311	        )
312	
313	        # Decode stage
314	        acceptance_lengths = []
315	        start = input_ids.shape[1]
316	        while start < max_length:
317	            block_output_ids = output_ids[:, start : start + block_size].clone()
318	            block_position_ids = position_ids[:, start : start + block_size]
319	            noise_embedding = target.model.embed_tokens(block_output_ids)
320	            draft_logits = target.lm_head(
321	                self(
322	                    target_hidden=target_hidden,
323	                    noise_embedding=noise_embedding,
324	                    position_ids=position_ids[
325	                        :, past_key_values_draft.get_seq_length() : start + block_size
326	                    ],
327	                    past_key_values=past_key_values_draft,
328	                    use_cache=True,
329	                    is_causal=False,
330	                )[:, -block_size + 1 :, :]
331	            )
332	            past_key_values_draft.crop(start)
333	            block_output_ids[:, 1:] = sample(draft_logits)
334	
335	            output = target(
336	                block_output_ids,
337	                position_ids=block_position_ids,
338	                past_key_values=past_key_values_target,
339	                use_cache=True,
340	                output_hidden_states=True,
341	            )
342	
343	            posterior = sample(output.logits, temperature)
344	            acceptance_length = (
345	                (block_output_ids[:, 1:] == posterior[:, :-1])
346	                .cumprod(dim=1)
347	                .sum(dim=1)[0]
348	                .item()
349	            )
350	            output_ids[:, start : start + acceptance_length + 1] = block_output_ids[
351	                :, : acceptance_length + 1
352	            ]
353	            output_ids[:, start + acceptance_length + 1] = posterior[
354	                :, acceptance_length
355	            ]
356	            start += acceptance_length + 1
357	            past_key_values_target.crop(start)
358	            target_hidden = extract_context_feature(
359	                output.hidden_states, self.target_layer_ids
360	            )[:, : acceptance_length + 1, :]
361	            acceptance_lengths.append(acceptance_length + 1)
362	            if stop_token_ids is not None and any(
363	                stop_token_id in output_ids[:, num_input_tokens:]
364	                for stop_token_id in stop_token_ids
365	            ):
366	                break
367	        output_ids = output_ids[:, :max_length]
368	        output_ids = output_ids[:, output_ids[0] != self.mask_token_id]
369	        if stop_token_ids is not None:
370	            stop_token_ids = torch.tensor(stop_token_ids, device=output_ids.device)
371	            stop_token_indices = torch.isin(
372	                output_ids[0][num_input_tokens:], stop_token_ids
373	            ).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
374	            if stop_token_indices.numel() > 0:
375	                output_ids = output_ids[
376	                    :, : num_input_tokens + stop_token_indices[0] + 1
377	                ]
378	
379	        return output_ids
```

> DEVELOPER

深入调查 **discrete diffusion language model 量化论文 + DiT/视觉 diffusion FP4 量化论文**中，关于"**哪些层该量化、哪些不该**"的具体消融实验和工程结论。重点是 **逐层敏感性**（per-layer sensitivity），不是整体 PTQ vs QAT 对比。

## 不是图像 diffusion 是文本 diffusion
我说的"diffusion"是 **DFlash / LLaDA / Dream / DiffuLLaMA / MDLM** 这类**离散文本 block diffusion / masked diffusion language model**，用作 LLM speculative decoding draft 或独立生成模型。但视觉 DiT FP4 量化的层选择经验也有参考价值。

## 调研的核心论文（按优先级）

1. **QDLM** (arXiv:2508.14896)：LLaDA-8B-Base/Instruct + Dream 7B 的 GPTQ W4 量化。重点找：哪些层不能量化？是否跳过 lm_head / embedding / first layer / last layer？attention 各 proj 是否分开消融？
2. **DLLMQuant** (arXiv:2508.14090)：LLaDA + IA-AQ（Activation-aware Quantization）+ TMAS。重点找：bidirectional attention 的 K/V 是不是特殊处理？哪些 layer 标记为 "outlier-heavy"？
3. **Quant-dLLM** (arXiv:2510.03274)：LLaDA-8B 推到 2-bit。重点找：极低比特下哪些层必须保高精度？
4. **SVDQuant** (arXiv:2411.05007) + **NVFP4 + Nunchaku**：FLUX/SDXL DiT 的 FP4 量化。重点：哪些 Linear 用 SVD low-rank 旁路？哪些直接 FP4？skip connection 怎么处理？
5. **NVIDIA modelopt `nvfp4_omlp_only` / `nvfp4_mlp_only` 配方**：具体跳过哪些层？为什么 attention QKV 不量化？
6. **任何 spec decoding draft 模型 NVFP4 量化的 ablation**（EAGLE-3、Medusa、DFlash 工程报告）

## 想要的精确数据

### 1. 普遍敏感层（量化通常会显著掉点的层）
- **first / last transformer layer** — paper 是否实证它们更敏感？掉多少分？
- **lm_head / output projection** — 业界共识是不量化，但有没有 paper 给出 ppl/acc 变化数据？
- **attention QKV proj** vs **MLP up/gate/down** — 哪个更敏感？
- **embedding / lm_head 共享权重时怎么处理**？

### 2. dLLM 特有敏感层
- **bidirectional attention 的 K/V**：dLLM 是 bi-attention（不像 AR causal），K/V 看到全局 context。量化是否更难？
- **mask token 经过的第一个 Linear（input embedding 后第一层）**：mask token 占大量位置，激活分布异常。是否要单独保护？
- **RMSNorm/LayerNorm 之后的第一层**：DLLMQuant 的 IA-AQ 有没有针对性发现？

### 3. DiT FP4 层选择经验
- SVDQuant 哪些 Linear 用 rank-32 SVD 旁路？哪些直接 FP4 不旁路？
- **time embedding / class embedding 投影**：是不是必须高精度？
- skip connection 涉及的 Linear？

### 4. NVIDIA modelopt 官方配方
- `nvfp4_omlp_only`、`nvfp4_mlp_only`、`nvfp4_default` 三种配方具体覆盖哪些 layer 类型？
- 官方推荐 attention QKV 不量化的具体理由是什么？quality 数据？
- 是否区分 "输入是 hidden_states" vs "输入是 cross-attn context" 的 Linear？

### 5. cross-attention 量化（DFlash 特有需求）
- DFlash 对 **target_hidden（多层 concat）** 做 cross-attention 的 K/V proj：输入维度大（K×hidden）、激活 range 大
- 类似场景：T2I diffusion 的 text-to-image cross-attention，video diffusion 的 reference attention
- 这类 cross-attention 的 K/V 投影量化经验？

## 工具
WebSearch + WebFetch 直接读 arXiv PDF 摘要 / Method 章节 / 实验表格。不要只看 abstract。中英文都搜。

## 输出格式（< 1500 字）

### A. 普遍共识：哪些层"不量化"是业界标配
列 4-6 条，每条带来源 + 数据点。

### B. dLLM-specific 敏感层（QDLM/DLLMQuant/Quant-dLLM 的具体结论）
表格：layer 类型 / 量化方案 / quality 影响 / 来源

### C. DiT 经验对 dLLM 的可借鉴
列 3-5 条 trick，每条说明能不能搬到 DFlash text dLLM。

### D. NVIDIA modelopt 推荐配方
具体列 omlp_only 跳过的 layer 名清单。

### E. 给 DFlash 的精确建议（最关键）
按 layer 类型列：
- 必须量化（量化收益大、风险小）
- 必须不量化（量化风险大）
- 边界情况（需要消融）

每条带证据来源（论文实证 / 推断 / 工程惯例）。

每条结论必须给 arXiv ID 或链接。如果某个层选择没找到 paper 实证，就明说"理论推断"。

```
# Per-Layer Quantization Sensitivity Analysis

Based on the paper content provided, **the study does not include per-layer quantization sensitivity analysis or ablation tables examining layer-specific treatment**.

## What the Paper Actually Addresses

The research focuses on:

1. **Overall quantization strategies** - comparing weight-only (GPTQ, AWQ) vs. weight-activation methods (SmoothQuant, QuaRot, DuQuant)

2. **Broad evaluation dimensions**:
   - Bit-width effects (3-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit)
   - Task categories (QA, math, code)
   - Model types (base vs. instruction-tuned)

3. **Outlier analysis** - identifying "Normal Outliers" and "Massive Outliers" across layers generally, with noted concentration in "the second linear layer of the feed-forward network (FFN) modules"

## Missing Elements

The paper does **not provide**:
- Layer-specific quantization sensitivity rankings
- Treatment differences between attention (QKV) and MLP components
- Ablation studies showing which layers can tolerate aggressive quantization
- Skipping strategies for embeddings, language heads, or boundary layers
- Per-component quality tables

## Future Work Mentioned

The authors acknowledge limitations, stating they "leave" kernel optimization "for future work," but don't explicitly identify layer-granularity studies as a research direction for diffusion LLM quantization.
```

```
class Qwen3MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.intermediate_size = config.intermediate_size
        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size, bias=False)
        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size, bias=False)
        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(self.intermediate_size, self.hidden_size, bias=False)
        self.act_fn = ACT2FN[config.hidden_act]

    def forward(self, x):
        down_proj = self.down_proj(self.act_fn(self.gate_proj(x)) * self.up_proj(x))
        return down_proj
```

```
# DLLMQuant Per-Layer Analysis Findings

## Key Per-Layer Insights

**Attention Mechanism Vulnerability:**
The paper identifies that "the quantization error introduced by the matrix multiplication between the output of the softmax operation and value matrix in attention" serves as a critical error accumulation point. This specific component showed substantially lower error when left unquantized compared to quantized versions.

**Value Matrix Distribution Issues:**
Analysis of attention value matrices reveals "substantial variability across both token and channel dimensions," creating quantization challenges. Combined with softmax sparsity (concentrated near diagonal), this creates unfavorable conditions for standard quantization approaches.

## IA-AQ Layer Treatment

Rather than protecting specific layer indices universally, IA-AQ applies **dynamic, interaction-aware resource allocation**:

- Targets the attention module's value matrix specifically
- Uses softmax outputs as weighting factors during quantization parameter calculation
- Tests scaling factor adjustments (α ∈ {1.0, 0.8}) to minimize weighted error

This focuses precision where token interactions matter most, rather than uniformly protecting particular layers.

## TMAS Layer Sampling Strategy

TMAS doesn't use layer-wise tables but instead stratifies calibration across:

- **Time steps** within inference blocks (proportional sampling)
- **Mask ratio categories** (4 intervals: 0-0.2, 0.2-0.5, 0.5-0.8, 0.8-1.0)

This ensures representative calibration spanning the full temporal and masking distribution space across all layers simultaneously.

**No layer-specific protection tables appear in the paper.**
```

```
# Quant-dLLM: Block-Level Precision Allocation

Based on the paper, the ABMP (Adaptive Blockwise Mixed Precision) scheme allocates higher precision to the most critical model components, but **the document does not provide specific per-block sensitivity analysis tables** identifying which blocks receive 3-bit vs. 1-bit precision.

## What the Paper Reveals

The allocation strategy is **importance-driven and general**:

> "assign different orders to blocks by importance, granting higher effective precision to a small set of sensitive regions"

The method uses an importance matrix derived from calibration data and assigns:
- **3-bit precision** to the top 5% most important blocks (default)
- **1-bit precision** to the bottom 5% least important blocks  
- **2-bit precision** to remaining blocks (maintaining strict 2-bit average)

## Missing Implementation Details

The paper does not explicitly break down sensitivity by:
- Embedding layers vs. attention vs. feed-forward blocks
- Query/Key/Value projections vs. output projections
- First/middle/last layer positioning
- Layer normalization or classification heads (lm_head)

The importance scores aggregate across calibration data, but detailed per-component breakdowns are not provided in the published results. This information might appear in supplementary materials or released code at the GitHub repository mentioned.
```

```
Based on the provided paper, **SVDQuant does not specify which individual linear layers receive the rank-32 SVD decomposition**. The document describes the method applied to linear layers generally but lacks the layer-by-layer breakdown you're requesting.

## What the Paper States

The methodology applies to linear layers across diffusion model architectures:

> "we decompose the transformed weight as 𝑾^=𝑳₁𝑳₂+𝑹"

The paper demonstrates results on:
- **UNet-based models** (SDXL, SDXL-Turbo)
- **DiT-based models** (FLUX.1, PixArt-Σ, SANA)

## Missing Information

The document does **not provide**:
- Per-layer ablation studies showing individual layer contributions
- Specific layer names from FLUX.1 or SDXL receiving the decomposition
- Time embedding or skip connection handling details
- Exact architectural module lists where SVD is applied

## Implementation Details

The paper references Appendix D for implementation specifics, but even that section (which appears truncated in your excerpt) doesn't enumerate which layers receive the low-rank branch.

To obtain this information, you would need to consult the authors' open-source repositories linked in the paper or contact the research team directly.
```

```
I found several relevant research papers on quantization of diffusion-based language models. Here are the key results:

## Main Paper: QDLM

The QDLM paper presents the first systematic evaluation of post-training quantization on diffusion LLMs. The study conducts comprehensive evaluations on three recent diffusion-based language models: LLaDA-8B-Base, LLaDA-8B-Instruct, and Dream 7B-Base.

## Quantization Methods

For weight-only quantization, the study adopts GPTQ and AWQ baselines, which are widely used in LLM quantization. For weight-activation quantization, they evaluate SmoothQuant as well as rotation-based approaches including QuaRot and DuQuant.

## Key Findings

GPTQ consistently outperforms AWQ across most tasks. For weight-activation quantization, rotation-based methods such as DuQuant and QuaRot demonstrate clear advantages over SmoothQuant.

## Task-Specific Performance

While most PTQ methods perform competitively on general QA benchmarks, notable degradation occurs on more complex tasks such as math reasoning and code generation. The instruction-tuned LLaDA model exhibits greater robustness to quantization compared to the base counterpart.

## Related Work

The search also returned information on related quantization approaches like Quant-dLLM, which focuses on extreme low-bit (2-bit) quantization with specialized techniques for diffusion-based language models.
```

```
Based on the search results, here's what I found about NVIDIA ModelOpt's NVFP4 quantization configurations and layer skipping:

## NVFP4 Quantization Formats

For NVFP4 quantization, NVIDIA recommends nvfp4_mlp_only, nvfp4_experts_only, or nvfp4_omlp_only to achieve higher accuracy by restricting quantization to the MLP/expert layers while keeping the attention QKV projections unquantized.

## Key Configuration Options

**nvfp4_mlp_only**: This format can be used with the command: `--qformat nvfp4_mlp_only`

**nvfp4_omlp_only**: This is a quantization format similar to nvfp4_mlp_only but also quantizes the output projection layer in attention.

**nvfp4_experts_only**: This quantization config targets only MoE routed expert layers (excluding shared) with NVFP4 quantization.

## Skipping Layers in Quantization Config

To skip specific layers from quantization, you can manually add patterns like `"*mtp*": {"enable": False}` to the quantization config mtq.NVFP4_MLP_ONLY_CFG.

## AutoQuantize with Mixed Precision

You can specify an auto_quantize_bits constraint such as 4.8 for mixed precision quantization using NVFP4_DEFAULT_CFG & FP8_DEFAULT_CFG. AutoQuantize will automatically quantize highly sensitive layers in FP8_DEFAULT_CFG while keeping less sensitive layers in NVFP4_DEFAULT_CFG and even skip quantization for extremely sensitive layers.
```
