139	                (0, num_verify_tokens), -1, dtype=torch.long, device="cuda"
140	            ),
141	            retrive_cum_len=None,
142	            topk=topk,
143	            draft_token_num=num_verify_tokens,
144	            spec_steps=spec_steps,
145	            capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.FULL,
146	            seq_lens_sum=0,
147	            seq_lens_cpu=torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int32),
148	        )
149	
150	    def prepare_for_verify(self, batch: ScheduleBatch, page_size: int):
151	
152	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
153	            return
154	
155	        batch.input_ids = self.draft_token
156	
157	        if page_size == 1:
158	            batch.out_cache_loc = alloc_token_slots(
159	                batch.tree_cache,
160	                len(batch.input_ids),
161	            )
162	            end_offset = batch.seq_lens + self.draft_token_num
163	        else:
164	            prefix_lens = batch.seq_lens
165	            prefix_lens_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu
166	            end_offset = prefix_lens + self.draft_token_num
167	            end_offset_cpu = prefix_lens_cpu + self.draft_token_num
168	            last_loc = get_last_loc(
169	                batch.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token,
170	                batch.req_pool_indices,
171	                prefix_lens,
172	            )
173	            batch.out_cache_loc = alloc_paged_token_slots_extend(
174	                batch.tree_cache,
175	                prefix_lens,
176	                prefix_lens_cpu,
177	                end_offset,
178	                end_offset_cpu,
179	                last_loc,
180	                len(batch.input_ids),
181	            )
182	            self.last_loc = last_loc
183	
184	        bs = batch.batch_size()
185	        assign_req_to_token_pool_func(
186	            batch.req_pool_indices,
187	            batch.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token,
188	            batch.seq_lens,
189	            end_offset,
190	            batch.out_cache_loc,
191	            bs,
192	        )
193	
194	        if get_global_server_args().enable_mamba_extra_buffer():
195	            mamba_next_track_idx = torch.tensor(
196	                [req.mamba_next_track_idx for req in batch.reqs],
197	                dtype=torch.int64,
198	                device=batch.device,
199	            )
200	            batch.mamba_track_indices = (
201	                batch.req_to_token_pool.req_index_to_mamba_ping_pong_track_buffer_mapping[
202	                    batch.req_pool_indices.to(torch.int64), mamba_next_track_idx
203	                ].to(torch.int64)
204	            )
205	
206	    def generate_attn_arg_prefill(
207	        self,
208	        req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
209	        paged_kernel_lens: torch.Tensor,
210	        paged_kernel_lens_sum: int,
211	        req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
212	    ):
213	        device = req_pool_indices.device
214	        batch_size = len(req_pool_indices)
215	        qo_indptr = torch.arange(
216	            0,
217	            (1 + batch_size) * self.draft_token_num,
218	            step=self.draft_token_num,
219	            dtype=torch.int32,
220	            device=device,
221	        )
222	        cum_kv_seq_len = torch.zeros(
223	            (batch_size + 1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
224	        )
225	
226	        paged_kernel_lens = paged_kernel_lens + self.draft_token_num
227	        cum_kv_seq_len[1:] = torch.cumsum(paged_kernel_lens, dim=0)
228	
229	        kv_indices = torch.empty(
230	            paged_kernel_lens_sum + self.draft_token_num * batch_size,
231	            dtype=torch.int32,
232	            device=device,
233	        )
234	        create_flashinfer_kv_indices_triton[(batch_size,)](
235	            req_to_token,
236	            req_pool_indices,
237	            paged_kernel_lens,
238	            cum_kv_seq_len,
239	            None,
240	            kv_indices,
241	            req_to_token.size(1),
242	        )
243	        mask_numel = (
244	            paged_kernel_lens_sum * self.draft_token_num
245	            + (self.draft_token_num**2) * batch_size
246	        )
247	        if self.custom_mask.numel() < mask_numel:
248	            # FIXME(attn): temporary fix for custom mask padding with cuda graph
249	            self.custom_mask = torch.cat(
250	                [
251	                    self.custom_mask,
252	                    torch.full(
253	                        (mask_numel - self.custom_mask.numel(),),
254	                        True,
255	                        dtype=torch.bool,
256	                        device=device,
257	                    ),
258	                ],
259	                dim=0,
260	            )
261	
262	        return kv_indices, cum_kv_seq_len, qo_indptr, self.custom_mask
263	
264	    def verify(
265	        self,
266	        batch: ScheduleBatch,
267	        logits_output: LogitsProcessorOutput,
268	        token_to_kv_pool_allocator: BaseTokenToKVPoolAllocator,
269	        page_size: int,
270	        vocab_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # For grammar
271	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
272	        """
273	        Verify and find accepted tokens based on logits output and batch
274	        (which contains spec decoding information).
275	
276	        WARNING: This API in-place modifies the states of logits_output
277	
278	        This API updates values inside logits_output based on the accepted
279	        tokens. I.e., logits_output.next_token_logits only contains
280	        accepted token logits.
281	        """
282	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
283	            return EagleVerifyOutput(
284	                draft_input=EagleDraftInput.create_idle_input(
285	                    device=batch.device,
286	                    hidden_size=batch.model_config.hidden_size,
287	                    dtype=batch.model_config.dtype,
288	                    topk=self.topk,
289	                    capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.LAST,
290	                ),
291	                logits_output=logits_output,
292	                verified_id=torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=batch.device),
293	                accept_length_per_req_cpu=[],
294	                accepted_indices=torch.full(
295	                    (0, self.spec_steps + 1),
296	                    -1,
297	                    dtype=torch.int32,
298	                    device=batch.device,
299	                ),
300	            )
301	
302	        bs = self.retrive_index.shape[0]
303	        candidates = self.draft_token.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num)
304	        sampling_info = batch.sampling_info
305	
306	        predict_shape = list(logits_output.next_token_logits.shape)[:-1]
307	        predict_shape[-1] += 1
308	        predict = torch.empty(predict_shape, dtype=torch.int32, device=batch.device)
309	        accept_index = torch.full(
310	            (bs, self.spec_steps + 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=batch.device
311	        )
312	        accept_length = torch.empty((bs,), dtype=torch.int32, device=batch.device)
313	
314	        if bs != len(sampling_info):
315	            sampling_info = copy.deepcopy(sampling_info)
316	            # NOTE: retrive_index are the indices of the requests that are kept.
317	            sampling_info.filter_batch(self.retrive_index.tolist(), self.retrive_index)
318	
319	        # Apply the custom logit processors if registered in the sampling info.
320	        if sampling_info.has_custom_logit_processor:
321	            apply_custom_logit_processor(
322	                logits_output.next_token_logits,
323	                sampling_info,
324	                num_tokens_in_batch=self.draft_token_num,
325	            )
326	
327	        # Apply penalty
328	        if (
329	            sampling_info.penalizer_orchestrator.is_required
330	            or sampling_info.logit_bias is not None
331	        ):
332	            # This is a relaxed version of penalties for speculative decoding.
333	            linear_penalty = torch.zeros(
334	                (bs, logits_output.next_token_logits.shape[1]),
335	                dtype=torch.float32,
336	                device=batch.device,
337	            )
338	            sampling_info.apply_logits_bias(linear_penalty)
339	            logits_output.next_token_logits.add_(
340	                torch.repeat_interleave(linear_penalty, self.draft_token_num, dim=0)
341	            )
342	
343	        # Apply grammar mask
344	        if vocab_mask is not None:
345	            assert self.grammar is not None
346	            self.grammar.apply_vocab_mask(
347	                logits=logits_output.next_token_logits, vocab_mask=vocab_mask
348	            )
349	
350	        # Sample tokens. Force greedy sampling on AMD
351	        is_all_greedy = sampling_info.is_all_greedy
352	        if (not is_all_greedy) and (not TREE_SPEC_KERNEL_AVAILABLE):
353	            logger.warning(
354	                "Tree speculative sampling kernel unavailable (likely AMD/HIP build). "
355	                "Falling back to greedy verification."
356	            )
357	
358	        if is_all_greedy or not TREE_SPEC_KERNEL_AVAILABLE:
359	          with torch.profiler.record_function("verify_tree_greedy"):
360	            # MARS (Margin-Aware Speculative verification, arXiv:2601.15498):
361	            # accept draft if it == argmax (top-1) OR (it == top-2 AND z2/z1 > theta).
362	            # Enabled when EAGLE_MARS_THETA >= 0; default disabled (-1.0) keeps standard SD.
363	            # Prefer per-instance theta (set by EAGLEWorker._apply_spec_config
364	            # for dynamic D5/D7 modes). Fall back to module-level _MARS_THETA
365	            # only when caller didn't plumb it (legacy single-mode workers /
366	            # idle EagleVerifyInput from cuda_graph_runner.get_spec_info).
367	            inst_theta = getattr(self, "mars_theta", -1.0)
368	            mars_theta = float(inst_theta) if inst_theta >= 0.0 else float(_MARS_THETA)
369	            if mars_theta >= 0.0:
370	                top2 = torch.topk(logits_output.next_token_logits, 2, dim=-1)
371	                target_predict = top2.indices[..., 0].reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num)
372	                top2_token = top2.indices[..., 1].reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num).contiguous()
373	                z1 = top2.values[..., 0]
374	                z2 = top2.values[..., 1]
375	                # ratio = z2/z1 only when z1 > 0; else -1.0 (never triggers MARS)
376	                ratio = torch.where(z1 > 0, z2 / z1, torch.full_like(z2, -1.0))
377	                top2_ratio = ratio.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num).contiguous().float()
378	            else:
379	                target_predict = torch.argmax(logits_output.next_token_logits, dim=-1)
380	                target_predict = target_predict.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num)
381	                top2_token = None
382	                top2_ratio = None
383	
384	            predict, accept_index, accept_length = verify_tree_greedy_func(
385	                predicts=predict,  # mutable
386	                accept_index=accept_index,  # mutable
387	                accept_token_num=accept_length,  # mutable
388	                candidates=candidates,
389	                retrive_index=self.retrive_index,
390	                [REDACTED],
391	                retrive_next_sibling=self.retrive_next_sibling,
392	                target_predict=target_predict,
393	                topk=self.topk,
394	                top2_token=top2_token,
395	                top2_ratio=top2_ratio,
396	                mars_theta=mars_theta,
397	            )
398	
399	        else:
400	            # apply temperature and get target probs
401	            expanded_temperature = torch.repeat_interleave(
402	                sampling_info.temperatures, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
403	            )  # (bs * draft_token_num, 1)
404	
405	            target_probs = F.softmax(
406	                logits_output.next_token_logits / expanded_temperature, dim=-1
407	            )  # (bs * draft_token_num, vocab_size)
408	            target_probs = top_k_renorm_prob(
409	                target_probs,
410	                torch.repeat_interleave(
411	                    sampling_info.top_ks, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
412	                ),
413	            )  # (bs * draft_token_num, vocab_size)
414	            if not torch.all(sampling_info.top_ps == 1.0):
415	                target_probs = top_p_renorm_prob(
416	                    target_probs,
417	                    torch.repeat_interleave(
418	                        sampling_info.top_ps, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
419	                    ),
420	                )
421	            target_probs = target_probs.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num, -1)
422	
423	            draft_probs = torch.zeros(
424	                target_probs.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=batch.device
425	            )
426	
427	            # coins for rejection sampling
428	            coins = torch.rand_like(
429	                candidates, dtype=torch.float32, device=batch.device
430	            )
431	            # coins for final sampling
432	            coins_for_final_sampling = torch.rand(
433	                (bs,), dtype=torch.float32, device=batch.device
434	            )
435	            tree_speculative_sampling_target_only(
436	                predicts=predict,  # mutable
437	                accept_index=accept_index,  # mutable
438	                accept_token_num=accept_length,  # mutable
439	                candidates=candidates,
440	                retrive_index=self.retrive_index,
441	                [REDACTED],
442	                retrive_next_sibling=self.retrive_next_sibling,
443	                uniform_samples=coins,
444	                uniform_samples_for_final_sampling=coins_for_final_sampling,
445	                target_probs=target_probs,
446	                draft_probs=draft_probs,
447	                threshold_single=get_global_server_args().speculative_accept_threshold_single,
448	                threshold_acc=get_global_server_args().speculative_accept_threshold_acc,
449	                deterministic=True,
450	            )
451	
452	        if SIMULATE_ACC_LEN > 0.0:
453	            # Do simulation
454	            accept_index = generate_simulated_accept_index(
455	                accept_index=accept_index,
456	                predict=predict,  # mutable
457	                accept_length=accept_length,  # mutable
458	                bs=bs,
459	                spec_steps=self.spec_steps,
460	            )
461	
462	        if _FORCE_NO_ACCEPT:
463	            # Profile hack: force all draft tokens rejected. Keep user_4813494d only.
464	            accept_index[:, 1:] = -1
465	            accept_length.zero_()
466	
467	        if _EAGLE_TRACE_PATH:
468	            try:
469	                dtn = self.draft_token_num
470	                _tr_logits_v = logits_output.next_token_logits.view(bs, dtn, -1).float()
471	                _tr_top2_v, _tr_top2_i = torch.topk(_tr_logits_v, 2, dim=-1)
472	                _tr_top2_v_cpu = _tr_top2_v.cpu().tolist()
473	                _tr_top2_i_cpu = _tr_top2_i.cpu().tolist()
474	                _tr_draft = self.draft_token.view(bs, dtn).cpu().tolist()
475	                _tr_accept_idx = accept_index.cpu().tolist()
476	                _tr_accept_len = accept_length.cpu().tolist()
477	                _tr_predict = predict.cpu().tolist()
478	                _tr_hs = logits_output.hidden_states.view(bs, dtn, -1).float()
479	                _tr_hs_norm = _tr_hs.norm(dim=-1).cpu().tolist()
480	                _tr_hs_sample = _tr_hs[:, :, :3].cpu().tolist()
481	                _tr_sl = batch.seq_lens_cpu.tolist()
482	                _tr_pos = self.positions.view(bs, dtn).cpu().tolist()
483	                _tr_ri = self.retrive_index.cpu().tolist()
484	                _tr_rnt = self.retrive_next_token.cpu().tolist()
485	                _tr_rns = self.retrive_next_sibling.cpu().tolist()
486	                for _i, _req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
487	                    _eagle_trace_emit({
488	                        "rid": str(_req.rid)[:12],
489	                        "kind": "verify",
490	                        "step": int(_req.spec_verify_ct),
491	                        "sl": int(_tr_sl[_i]),
492	                        "topk": int(self.topk),
493	                        "spec_steps": int(self.spec_steps),
494	                        "dtn": int(dtn),
495	                        "dt": _tr_draft[_i],
496	                        "pos": _tr_pos[_i],
497	                        "ri": _tr_ri[_i],
498	                        "rnt": _tr_rnt[_i],
499	                        "rns": _tr_rns[_i],
500	                        "t2i": _tr_top2_i_cpu[_i],
501	                        "t2v": [[round(v, 4) for v in pair] for pair in _tr_top2_v_cpu[_i]],
502	                        "ai": _tr_accept_idx[_i],
503	                        "al": int(_tr_accept_len[_i]),
504	                        "pr": _tr_predict[_i * dtn:(_i + 1) * dtn],
505	                        "hn": [round(x, 6) for x in _tr_hs_norm[_i]],
506	                        "hs3": [[round(c, 4) for c in hs] for hs in _tr_hs_sample[_i]],
507	                        "ot": list(_req.output_ids[-4:]),
508	                    })
509	            except Exception as _e:
510	                logger.warning(f"eagle trace emit failed: {_e}")
511	
512	        unfinished_index = []
513	        unfinished_accept_index = []
514	        with torch.profiler.record_function("DC_verify_ai_tolist"):
515	            accept_index_cpu = accept_index.tolist()
516	            predict_cpu = predict.tolist()
517	        has_finished = False
518	
519	        # Iterate every accepted token and check if req has finished after append the token
520	        # should be checked BEFORE free kv cache slots
521	        _verify_pyloop_ctx = torch.profiler.record_function("DC_verify_pyloop")
522	        _verify_pyloop_ctx.__enter__()
523	        for i, (req, accept_index_row) in enumerate(zip(batch.reqs, accept_index_cpu)):
524	            for j, idx in enumerate(accept_index_row):
525	                if idx == -1:
526	                    break
527	                id = predict_cpu[idx]
528	                req.output_ids.append(id)
529	                req.check_finished()
530	                if req.finished():
531	                    has_finished = True
532	                    if isinstance(req.finished_reason, FINISH_MATCHED_TOKEN):
533	                        logger.info(
534	                            "\033[31m[EOS] req %s hit EOS token=%d at output_len=%d\033[0m",
535	                            getattr(req, "rid", "?"),
536	                            id,
537	                            len(req.output_ids),
538	                        )
539	                    # set all tokens after finished token to -1 and break
540	                    accept_index[i, j + 1 :] = -1
541	                    break
542	                else:
543	                    if req.grammar is not None:
544	                        try:
545	                            req.grammar.accept_token(id)
546	                        except ValueError as e:
547	                            logger.info(
548	                                f"{i=}, {req=}\n" f"{accept_index=}\n" f"{predict=}\n"
549	                            )
550	                            raise e
551	            if not req.finished():
552	                unfinished_index.append(i)
553	                if idx == -1:
554	                    unfinished_accept_index.append(accept_index[i, :j])
555	                else:
556	                    unfinished_accept_index.append(accept_index[i])
557	            req.spec_verify_ct += 1
558	            spec_accepted_this_step = (
559	                sum(1 for idx in accept_index_row if idx != -1) - 1
560	            )
561	            req.spec_accepted_tokens += spec_accepted_this_step
562	            # Collapse instrumentation: track consecutive al==0 streaks per rid.
563	            if _COLLAPSE_LOG_K > 0:
564	                rid = getattr(req, "rid", None)
565	                if rid is not None:
566	                    if spec_accepted_this_step == 0:
567	                        with _COLLAPSE_LOG_LOCK:
568	                            n = _COLLAPSE_COUNTERS.get(rid, 0) + 1
569	                            _COLLAPSE_COUNTERS[rid] = n
570	                        if n == _COLLAPSE_LOG_K:
571	                            logger.warning(
572	                                "[eagle-collapse] rid=%s consec_al0=%d "
573	                                "spec_verify_ct=%d output_len=%d — draft "
574	                                "predicting outside top-2 in long-context",
575	                                str(rid)[:12], n, req.spec_verify_ct,
576	                                len(req.output_ids),
577	                            )
578	                    elif rid in _COLLAPSE_COUNTERS:
579	                        with _COLLAPSE_LOG_LOCK:
580	                            _COLLAPSE_COUNTERS.pop(rid, None)
581	
582	        _verify_pyloop_ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
583	
584	        if has_finished:
585	            accept_length = (accept_index != -1).sum(dim=1) - 1
586	
587	        with torch.profiler.record_function("DC_verify_al_cpu"):
588	            accept_length_cpu = accept_length.cpu()
589	            # FIXME: this `tolist()` fixes the numerical calculation consistency
590	            # try to unify the tensor representation and list representation
591	            accept_length_list = accept_length_cpu.tolist()
592	            accepted_count = sum(accept_length_list) + len(accept_length_list)
593	
594	        # Free the KV cache for unaccepted tokens.
595	        free_slots = None
596	        with torch.profiler.record_function("verify_kv_evict_mask"):
597	            if (
598	                _FUSE_VERIFY_FREE_SLOTS
599	                and page_size == 1
600	                and accept_index.is_cuda
601	            ):
602	                accept_index, verified_id, free_slots = (
603	                    compact_accept_index_and_free_slots_func(
604	                        accept_index,
605	                        accept_length,
606	                        predict,
607	                        batch.out_cache_loc,
608	                        self.draft_token_num,
609	                        accepted_count,
610	                    )
611	                )
612	                evict_mask = None
613	            elif _FUSE_VERIFY_ACCEPT_COMPACT and accept_index.is_cuda:
614	                accept_index, verified_id, evict_mask = (
615	                    compact_accept_index_and_evict_mask_func(
616	                        accept_index,
617	                        accept_length,
618	                        predict,
619	                        self.draft_token_num,
620	                        accepted_count,
621	                    )
622	                )
623	            else:
624	                accept_index = accept_index[accept_index != -1]
625	                verified_id = predict[accept_index]
626	                evict_mask = torch.full_like(self.draft_token, True, dtype=torch.bool)
627	                evict_mask[accept_index] = False
628	
629	        if page_size == 1:
630	            # TODO: boolean array index leads to a device sync. Remove it.
631	            if free_slots is not None:
632	                token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free(free_slots)
633	            else:
634	                token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free(batch.out_cache_loc[evict_mask])
635	            for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
636	                req.kv_committed_len += accept_length_list[i] + 1
637	                req.kv_allocated_len = req.kv_committed_len
638	        else:
639	            if self.topk == 1:
640	                # Only evict full empty page. Do not evict partial empty page
641	                align_evict_mask_to_page_size[len(batch.seq_lens),](
642	                    batch.seq_lens,
643	                    evict_mask,
644	                    page_size,
645	                    self.draft_token_num,
646	                    next_power_of_2(self.draft_token_num),
647	                )
648	                token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free(batch.out_cache_loc[evict_mask])
649	                for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
650	                    req.kv_committed_len += accept_length_list[i] + 1
651	                    req.kv_allocated_len = req.kv_committed_len
652	            else:
653	                # Shift the accepted tokens to the beginning.
654	                # Only evict the last part
655	                src_cache_loc, tgt_cache_loc, to_free_num_slots = get_src_tgt_cache_loc(
656	                    batch.seq_lens,
657	                    batch.out_cache_loc,
658	                    accept_index,
659	                    accept_length,
660	                    self.draft_token_num,
661	                    page_size,
662	                )
663	                to_free_slots = torch.empty(
664	                    (to_free_num_slots.sum().item(),),
665	                    dtype=torch.int64,
666	                    device=to_free_num_slots.device,
667	                )
668	
669	                # out_cache_loc: [0  1  2,  3  4  5,  6  7  8]
670	                # accept_index:  [0 -1  2,  3  4 -1,  6 -1 -1]
671	                # tgt_cache_loc: [0  1   ,  3  4   ,  6      ]
672	                # to_free_slots: [      2,        5,     7  8]
673	                # to_free_slots also needs to be page-aligned without the first partial page
674	                #
675	                # split each row of out_cache_loc into two parts.
676	                # 1. the first part goes to tgt_cache_loc. length = accept_length[i] + 1
677	                # 2. the second part goes to to_free_slots.
678	                get_target_cache_loc[(bs,)](
679	                    tgt_cache_loc,
680	                    to_free_slots,
681	                    accept_length,
682	                    to_free_num_slots,
683	                    batch.out_cache_loc,
684	                    self.draft_token_num,
685	                    next_power_of_2(self.draft_token_num),
686	                    next_power_of_2(bs),
687	                )
688	
689	                # Free the kv cache
690	                token_to_kv_pool_allocator.free(to_free_slots)
691	
692	                # Copy the kv cache
693	                batch.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.get_kvcache().move_kv_cache(
694	                    tgt_cache_loc, src_cache_loc
695	                )
696	
697	        # Construct EagleVerifyOutput
698	        if not has_finished:
699	            with torch.profiler.record_function("DC_verify_assign_pool"):
700	                if page_size == 1 or self.topk == 1:
701	                    batch.out_cache_loc = batch.out_cache_loc[accept_index]
702	                    assign_req_to_token_pool_func(
703	                        batch.req_pool_indices,
704	                        batch.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token,
705	                        batch.seq_lens,
706	                        batch.seq_lens + accept_length + 1,
707	                        batch.out_cache_loc,
708	                        bs,
709	                    )
710	                else:
711	                    batch.out_cache_loc = tgt_cache_loc
712	                batch.seq_lens.add_(accept_length + 1)
713	                batch.seq_lens_cpu.add_(accept_length_cpu + 1)
714	
715	            draft_input = EagleDraftInput(
716	                hidden_states=batch.spec_info.hidden_states[accept_index],
717	                verified_id=verified_id,
718	                accept_length=accept_length,
719	                accept_length_cpu=accept_length_list,
720	                seq_lens_for_draft_extend=batch.seq_lens,
721	                seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu=batch.seq_lens_cpu,
722	                req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend=batch.req_pool_indices,
723	                request_keep_indices=list(range(bs)),
724	            )
725	
726	            return EagleVerifyOutput(
727	                draft_input=draft_input,
728	                logits_output=logits_output,
729	                verified_id=verified_id,
730	                accept_length_per_req_cpu=draft_input.accept_length_cpu,
731	                accepted_indices=accept_index,
732	            )
733	        else:
734	            if page_size == 1 or self.topk == 1:
735	                assign_req_to_token_pool_func(
736	                    batch.req_pool_indices,
737	                    batch.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token,
738	                    batch.seq_lens,
739	                    batch.seq_lens + accept_length + 1,
740	                    batch.out_cache_loc[accept_index],
741	                    bs,
742	                )
743	                batch.seq_lens.add_(accept_length + 1)
744	                batch.seq_lens_cpu.add_(accept_length_cpu + 1)
745	
746	            if len(unfinished_accept_index) > 0:
747	                unfinished_accept_index = torch.cat(unfinished_accept_index)
748	                unfinished_index_device = torch.tensor(
749	                    unfinished_index, dtype=torch.int64, device=predict.device
750	                )
751	                draft_input_accept_length_cpu = [
752	                    accept_length_list[i] for i in unfinished_index
753	                ]
754	                if page_size == 1 or self.topk == 1:
755	                    batch.out_cache_loc = batch.out_cache_loc[unfinished_accept_index]
756	                else:
757	                    batch.out_cache_loc = torch.empty(
758	                        len(unfinished_index) + sum(draft_input_accept_length_cpu),
759	                        dtype=torch.int64,
760	                        device=predict.device,
761	                    )
762	                    accept_length_filter = create_accept_length_filter(
763	                        accept_length,
764	                        unfinished_index_device,
765	                        batch.seq_lens,
766	                    )
767	                    batch.seq_lens_cpu.add_(accept_length_cpu + 1)
768	                    filter_finished_cache_loc_kernel[(bs,)](
769	                        batch.out_cache_loc,
770	                        tgt_cache_loc,
771	                        accept_length,
772	                        accept_length_filter,
773	                        next_power_of_2(bs),
774	                        next_power_of_2(self.draft_token_num),
775	                    )
776	
777	                draft_input = EagleDraftInput(
778	                    hidden_states=batch.spec_info.hidden_states[
779	                        unfinished_accept_index
780	                    ],
781	                    verified_id=predict[unfinished_accept_index],
782	                    accept_length_cpu=draft_input_accept_length_cpu,
783	                    accept_length=accept_length[unfinished_index_device],
784	                    seq_lens_for_draft_extend=batch.seq_lens[unfinished_index_device],
785	                    seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu=batch.seq_lens_cpu[unfinished_index],
786	                    req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend=batch.req_pool_indices[
787	                        unfinished_index_device
788	                    ],
789	                    request_keep_indices=unfinished_index,
790	                )
791	            else:
792	                draft_input = EagleDraftInput.create_idle_input(
793	                    device=batch.device,
794	                    hidden_size=batch.model_config.hidden_size,
795	                    dtype=batch.model_config.dtype,
796	                    topk=self.topk,
797	                    capture_hidden_mode=CaptureHiddenMode.LAST,
798	                )
799	
800	            return EagleVerifyOutput(
801	                draft_input=draft_input,
802	                logits_output=logits_output,
803	                verified_id=verified_id,
804	                accept_length_per_req_cpu=accept_length_list,
805	                accepted_indices=accept_index,
806	            )

849	    def __post_init__(self):
850	        super().__init__(SpecInputType.EAGLE_DRAFT)

855	    def prepare_for_extend(self, batch: ScheduleBatch):
856	
857	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
858	            return
859	
860	        # Prefill only generate 1 token.
861	        assert len(self.verified_id) == len(batch.seq_lens)
862	
863	        pt = 0
864	        for i, extend_len in enumerate(batch.extend_lens):
865	            input_ids = batch.input_ids[pt : pt + extend_len]
866	            batch.input_ids[pt : pt + extend_len] = torch.cat(
867	                (input_ids[1:], self.verified_id[i].reshape(1))
868	            )
869	            pt += extend_len
870	
871	    @classmethod
872	    def create_idle_input(
873	        cls,
874	        device: torch.device,
875	        hidden_size: int,
876	        dtype: torch.dtype,
877	        topk: int,
878	        capture_hidden_mode: CaptureHiddenMode,
879	    ):
880	        return cls(
881	            verified_id=torch.empty((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
882	            hidden_states=torch.empty((0, hidden_size), device=device, dtype=dtype),
883	            topk_p=torch.empty((0, topk), device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
884	            topk_index=torch.empty((0, topk), device=device, dtype=torch.int64),
885	            capture_hidden_mode=capture_hidden_mode,
886	            new_seq_lens=torch.empty((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
887	            accept_length=torch.empty((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
888	            accept_length_cpu=[],
889	            request_keep_indices=[],
890	        )
891	
892	    def prepare_extend_after_decode(
893	        self,
894	        batch: ScheduleBatch,
895	        speculative_num_steps: int,
896	    ):
897	
898	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
899	            return
900	
901	        batch.input_ids = self.verified_id
902	        batch.extend_lens = [x + 1 for x in batch.spec_info.accept_length_cpu]
903	        batch.extend_num_tokens = sum(batch.extend_lens)
904	        batch.seq_lens = batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend
905	        batch.seq_lens_cpu = batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu
906	        batch.req_pool_indices = batch.spec_info.req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend
907	        batch.return_logprob = False
908	        batch.return_hidden_states = False
909	
910	        self.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST
911	        self.accept_length.add_(1)
912	        self.positions = torch.empty_like(batch.input_ids, dtype=torch.long)
913	        self.verified_id = torch.empty_like(self.accept_length, dtype=torch.int32)
914	
915	        create_extend_after_decode_spec_info[(len(batch.seq_lens),)](
916	            batch.input_ids,
917	            batch.seq_lens,
918	            self.accept_length,
919	            self.positions,
920	            self.verified_id,
921	            next_power_of_2(max(speculative_num_steps + 1, len(batch.seq_lens))),
922	        )
923	
924	        if _EAGLE_TRACE_PATH:
925	            try:
926	                accept_lens_cpu = self.accept_length.cpu().tolist()
927	                seq_lens_cpu = batch.seq_lens.cpu().tolist()
928	                flat_input_ids = batch.input_ids.cpu().tolist()
929	                flat_positions = self.positions.cpu().tolist()
930	                flat_hidden = self.hidden_states.float()
931	                flat_hidden_norm = flat_hidden.norm(dim=-1).cpu().tolist()
932	                flat_hidden_sample = flat_hidden[:, :3].cpu().tolist()
933	                new_verified_id_cpu = self.verified_id.cpu().tolist()
934	
935	                pt = 0
936	                for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
937	                    cur_len = accept_lens_cpu[i]
938	                    seg_end = pt + cur_len
939	                    _eagle_trace_emit(
940	                        {
941	                            "kind": "dae",
942	                            "rid": str(req.rid)[:12],
943	                            "step": int(req.spec_verify_ct),
944	                            "sl": int(seq_lens_cpu[i]),
945	                            "al": int(cur_len),
946	                            "inp": flat_input_ids[pt:seg_end],
947	                            "pos": flat_positions[pt:seg_end],
948	                            "vid": int(new_verified_id_cpu[i]),
949	                            "hn": [
950	                                round(x, 6)
951	                                for x in flat_hidden_norm[pt:seg_end]
952	                            ],
953	                            "hs3": [
954	                                [round(c, 4) for c in hs]
955	                                for hs in flat_hidden_sample[pt:seg_end]
956	                            ],
957	                        }
958	                    )
959	                    pt = seg_end
960	            except Exception as _e:
961	                logger.warning(f"eagle dae trace emit failed: {_e}")
962	
963	    def align_batch_for_draft_extend(self, batch: ScheduleBatch):
964	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
965	            return
966	
967	        keep_indices = self.request_keep_indices
968	        if keep_indices is None or len(keep_indices) == len(batch.reqs):
969	            return
970	
971	        keep_indices_device = torch.tensor(
972	            keep_indices, dtype=torch.int64, device=batch.device
973	        )
974	
975	        batch.reqs = [batch.reqs[i] for i in keep_indices]
976	
977	        if batch.multimodal_inputs is not None:
978	            batch.multimodal_inputs = [batch.multimodal_inputs[i] for i in keep_indices]
979	
980	        if batch.req_pool_indices is not None:
981	            batch.req_pool_indices = batch.req_pool_indices[keep_indices_device]
982	        if batch.seq_lens is not None:
983	            batch.seq_lens = batch.seq_lens[keep_indices_device]
984	        if batch.seq_lens_cpu is not None:
985	            batch.seq_lens_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu[keep_indices]
986	        if batch.orig_seq_lens is not None:
987	            batch.orig_seq_lens = batch.orig_seq_lens[keep_indices_device]
988	        if batch.output_ids is not None:
989	            batch.output_ids = batch.output_ids[keep_indices_device]
990	
991	        if batch.mamba_track_indices is not None:
992	            batch.mamba_track_indices = batch.mamba_track_indices[keep_indices_device]
993	        if batch.mamba_track_mask is not None:
994	            batch.mamba_track_mask = batch.mamba_track_mask[keep_indices_device]
995	        if batch.mamba_track_seqlens is not None:
996	            batch.mamba_track_seqlens = batch.mamba_track_seqlens[keep_indices_device]
997	
998	        batch.return_logprob = any(req.return_logprob for req in batch.reqs)
999	        if batch.return_logprob:
1000	            if batch.top_logprobs_nums is not None:
1001	                batch.top_logprobs_nums = [
1002	                    batch.top_logprobs_nums[i] for i in keep_indices
1003	                ]
1004	            if batch.token_ids_logprobs is not None:
1005	                batch.token_ids_logprobs = [
1006	                    batch.token_ids_logprobs[i] for i in keep_indices
1007	                ]
1008	        else:
1009	            batch.top_logprobs_nums = None
1010	            batch.token_ids_logprobs = None
1011	
1012	        batch.has_stream = any(req.stream for req in batch.reqs)
1013	        batch.has_grammar = any(req.grammar for req in batch.reqs)
1014	
1015	    def generate_attn_arg_prefill(
1016	        self,
1017	        req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
1018	        paged_kernel_lens: torch.Tensor,
1019	        paged_kernel_lens_sum: int,
1020	        req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
1021	    ):
1022	        device = req_pool_indices.device
1023	        bs = self.accept_length.numel()
1024	        use_cpu_indptr = (
1025	            _DRAFT_EXTEND_CPU_INDPTR
1026	            and self.accept_length_cpu is not None
1027	            and len(self.accept_length_cpu) == bs
1028	            and self.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu is not None
1029	            and len(self.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu) == bs
1030	        )
1031	
1032	        qo_indptr_gpu = torch.zeros((bs + 1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
1033	        qo_indptr_gpu[1:] = torch.cumsum(self.accept_length, dim=0)
1034	        cum_kv_seq_len_gpu = torch.zeros((bs + 1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
1035	        cum_kv_seq_len_gpu[1:] = torch.cumsum(paged_kernel_lens, dim=0)
1036	
1037	        if use_cpu_indptr:
1038	            accept_length_cpu = torch.tensor(
1039	                self.accept_length_cpu, dtype=torch.int32
1040	            )
1041	            qo_indptr = torch.empty((bs + 1,), dtype=torch.int32)
1042	            qo_indptr[0] = 0
1043	            # prepare_extend_after_decode increments accept_length on GPU before
1044	            # attention metadata replay; the CPU list stores the pre-increment
1045	            # accepted draft-token count.
1046	            qo_indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(accept_length_cpu + 1, dim=0)
1047	
1048	            cum_kv_seq_len = torch.empty((bs + 1,), dtype=torch.int32)
1049	            cum_kv_seq_len[0] = 0
1050	            cum_kv_seq_len[1:] = torch.cumsum(
1051	                self.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu.to(torch.int32), dim=0
1052	            )
1053	        else:
1054	            qo_indptr = qo_indptr_gpu
1055	            cum_kv_seq_len = cum_kv_seq_len_gpu
1056	
1057	        if paged_kernel_lens_sum is None:
1058	            paged_kernel_lens_sum = cum_kv_seq_len_gpu[-1]
1059	
1060	        kv_indices = torch.empty(
1061	            paged_kernel_lens_sum, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
1062	        )
1063	
1064	        create_flashinfer_kv_indices_triton[(bs,)](
1065	            req_to_token,
1066	            req_pool_indices,
1067	            paged_kernel_lens,
1068	            cum_kv_seq_len_gpu,
1069	            None,
1070	            kv_indices,
1071	            req_to_token.size(1),
1072	        )
1073	        return kv_indices, cum_kv_seq_len, qo_indptr, None
1074	
1075	    def filter_batch(self, new_indices: torch.Tensor, has_been_filtered: bool = True):
1076	        if self.future_indices is not None:
1077	            self.future_indices.indices = self.future_indices.indices[new_indices]
1078	            return
1079	
1080	        if self.topk_p is None:
1081	            if has_been_filtered:
1082	                self.request_keep_indices = list(range(len(new_indices)))
1083	                return
1084	
1085	            strict_check = envs.SGLANG_SPEC_ENABLE_STRICT_FILTER_CHECK.get()
1086	            error_msg = (
1087	                "EagleDraftInput extend-only state was asked to filter by original "
1088	                "batch indices. This should have been pre-filtered already."
1089	            )
1090	            if strict_check:
1091	                raise ValueError(error_msg)
1092	            logger.warning(error_msg)
1093	            return
1094	
1095	        strict_check = envs.SGLANG_SPEC_ENABLE_STRICT_FILTER_CHECK.get()
1096	        if has_been_filtered:
1097	            # in eagle_utils.py:verify, we have already filtered the batch by `unfinished_index`
1098	            # therefore, we don't need to filter the batch again in scheduler
1099	            error_msg = f"length of new_indices: {len(new_indices)} != length of topk_p: {len(self.topk_p)}, this should not happen"
1100	            if len(new_indices) != len(self.topk_p):
1101	                if strict_check:
1102	                    raise ValueError(error_msg)
1103	                else:
1104	                    logger.warning(error_msg)
1105	
1106	            self.topk_p = self.topk_p[: len(new_indices)]
1107	            self.topk_index = self.topk_index[: len(new_indices)]
1108	            self.hidden_states = self.hidden_states[: len(new_indices)]
1109	            self.verified_id = self.verified_id[: len(new_indices)]
1110	        else:
1111	            # in some cases(e.g draft_extend), we have not filtered the batch by `unfinished_index`
1112	            self.topk_p = self.topk_p[new_indices]
1113	            self.topk_index = self.topk_index[new_indices]
1114	            self.hidden_states = self.hidden_states[new_indices]
1115	            self.verified_id = self.verified_id[new_indices]
1116	
1117	    def merge_batch(self, spec_info: "EagleDraftInput"):
1118	        if self.future_indices is not None:
1119	            assert spec_info.future_indices is not None
1120	            self.future_indices = FutureIndices(
1121	                indices=torch.cat(
1122	                    [self.future_indices.indices, spec_info.future_indices.indices]
1123	                )
1124	            )
1125	            return
1126	
1127	        if self.hidden_states is None:
1128	            self.hidden_states = spec_info.hidden_states
1129	            self.verified_id = spec_info.verified_id
1130	            self.topk_p = spec_info.topk_p
1131	            self.topk_index = spec_info.topk_index
1132	            return
1133	        if spec_info.hidden_states is None:
1134	            return
1135	        self.hidden_states = torch.cat(
1136	            [self.hidden_states, spec_info.hidden_states], axis=0
1137	        )
1138	        self.verified_id = torch.cat([self.verified_id, spec_info.verified_id], axis=0)
1139	        self.topk_p = torch.cat([self.topk_p, spec_info.topk_p])
1140	        self.topk_index = torch.cat([self.topk_index, spec_info.topk_index])
1141

1157	@dataclass
1158	class MedusaVerifyInput(SpecInput):
1159	    """Minimal spec_info for Medusa batched TARGET_VERIFY.
1160	
1161	    Unlike EAGLE's tree-based verification, Medusa uses flat (sequential)
1162	    draft tokens: [verified_id, draft_0, draft_1, ..., draft_{K-1}].
1163	    """
1164	
1165	    draft_token: torch.Tensor  # (bs * draft_token_num,) flattened input_ids
1166	    positions: torch.Tensor  # (bs * draft_token_num,) position ids
1167	    draft_token_num: int  # K+1 (verified + K drafts)
1168	    topk: int = 1  # always 1 for flat Medusa (no tree)
1169	    capture_hidden_mode: CaptureHiddenMode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST
1170	    seq_lens_sum: int = 0
1171	    seq_lens_cpu: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
1172	
1173	    # Shape info for padding
1174	    num_tokens_per_batch: int = -1
1175	
1176	    def __post_init__(self):
1177	        super().__init__(SpecInputType.MEDUSA_VERIFY)
1178	
1179	    def get_spec_adjust_token_coefficient(self):
1180	        return self.draft_token_num, self.draft_token_num
1181	
1182	    @classmethod
1183	    def create_idle_input(cls, draft_token_num: int):

259	    def sample(
260	        self: EagleVerifyInput,
261	        batch: ModelWorkerBatch,
262	        logits_output: LogitsProcessorOutput,
263	        vocab_mask: torch.Tensor = None,
264	    ):
265	        """
266	        Verify and find accepted tokens based on logits output and batch
267	        (which contains spec decoding information).
268	        """
269	        if batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
270	            predict = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=batch.input_ids.device)
271	            accept_length = torch.empty(
272	                0, dtype=torch.int32, device=batch.input_ids.device
273	            )
274	            accept_index = torch.empty(
275	                0, dtype=torch.int32, device=batch.input_ids.device
276	            )
277	            return predict, accept_length, accept_index
278	
279	        bs = len(batch.seq_lens)
280	        sampling_info = batch.sampling_info
281	        next_token_logits = logits_output.next_token_logits
282	        device = batch.input_ids.device
283	
284	        # Apply grammar mask if provided
285	        if vocab_mask is not None:
286	            assert self.grammar is not None
287	            self.grammar.apply_vocab_mask(
288	                logits=next_token_logits, vocab_mask=vocab_mask
289	            )
290	
291	        candidates = self.draft_token.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num)
292	        predict_shape = list(next_token_logits.shape)[:-1]
293	        predict = torch.zeros(predict_shape, dtype=torch.int32, device=device).flatten()
294	        accept_index = torch.full(
295	            (bs, self.spec_steps + 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
296	        )
297	        accept_length = torch.empty((bs,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
298	
299	        # Sample tokens
300	        if sampling_info.is_all_greedy or _is_npu:
301	            target_predict = torch.argmax(next_token_logits, dim=-1)
302	            target_predict = target_predict.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num)
303	            predict, accept_index, accept_length = verify_tree_greedy_func(
304	                predicts=predict,  # mutable
305	                accept_index=accept_index,  # mutable
306	                accept_token_num=accept_length,  # mutable
307	                candidates=candidates,
308	                retrive_index=self.retrive_index,
309	                [REDACTED],
310	                retrive_next_sibling=self.retrive_next_sibling,
311	                target_predict=target_predict,
312	                topk=self.topk,
313	            )
314	        else:
315	            # Apply temperature and get target probs
316	            expanded_temperature = torch.repeat_interleave(
317	                sampling_info.temperatures, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
318	            )  # (bs * num_draft_tokens, 1)
319	
320	            target_probs = F.softmax(
321	                next_token_logits / expanded_temperature, dim=-1
322	            )  # (bs * num_draft_tokens, vocab_size)
323	            target_probs = top_k_renorm_prob(
324	                target_probs,
325	                torch.repeat_interleave(
326	                    sampling_info.top_ks, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
327	                ),
328	            )  # (bs * num_draft_tokens, vocab_size)
329	            target_probs = top_p_renorm_prob(
330	                target_probs,
331	                torch.repeat_interleave(
332	                    sampling_info.top_ps, self.draft_token_num, dim=0
333	                ),
334	            )
335	            target_probs = target_probs.reshape(bs, self.draft_token_num, -1)
336	            draft_probs = torch.zeros_like(target_probs)
337	
338	            # coins for rejection sampling
339	            coins = torch.rand_like(candidates, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

353	                uniform_samples=coins,

355	                target_probs=target_probs,

378	@triton.jit
379	def fill_new_verified_id(
380	    verified_id,
381	    accept_lens,
382	    new_verified_id,
383	    num_draft_tokens: tl.constexpr,
384	):
385	    # NOTE: we cannot fuse any in-place operations of `accept_lens` inside this kernel
386	    # because this kernel reads accept_lens
387	    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
388	    accept_length = tl.load(accept_lens + pid)
389	
390	    verified_id_idx = num_draft_tokens * pid + accept_length - 1
391	    verified_id_data = tl.load(verified_id + verified_id_idx)
392	    tl.store(new_verified_id + pid, verified_id_data)

395	@triton.jit
396	def fill_accepted_out_cache_loc(
397	    accept_index,
398	    out_cache_loc,
399	    accepted_out_cache_loc,
400	    size_upper: tl.constexpr,
401	):
402	    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
403	    offset = tl.arange(0, size_upper)
404	
405	    masks = (tl.load(accept_index + offset, offset < pid, other=-1) != -1).to(tl.int64)
406	    dst = tl.sum(masks)
407	    src = tl.load(accept_index + pid)
408	    if src > -1:
409	        value = tl.load(out_cache_loc + src)
410	        tl.store(accepted_out_cache_loc + dst, value)

413	@triton.jit
414	def assign_extend_cache_locs(
415	    req_pool_indices,
416	    req_to_token,
417	    start_offset,
418	    end_offset,
419	    out_cache_loc,
420	    pool_len: tl.constexpr,
421	    bs_upper: tl.constexpr,
422	):
423	    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr = 32
424	    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
425	    kv_start = tl.load(start_offset + pid)
426	    kv_end = tl.load(end_offset + pid)
427	    token_pool = req_to_token + tl.load(req_pool_indices + pid) * pool_len
428	
429	    length_offset = tl.arange(0, bs_upper)
430	    start = tl.load(start_offset + length_offset, mask=length_offset < pid, other=0)
431	    end = tl.load(end_offset + length_offset, mask=length_offset < pid, other=0)
432	    out_offset = tl.sum(end - start, axis=0)
433	
434	    out_cache_ptr = out_cache_loc + out_offset
435	
436	    load_offset = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE) + kv_start
437	    save_offset = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
438	
439	    num_loop = tl.cdiv(kv_end - kv_start, BLOCK_SIZE)
440	    for _ in range(num_loop):
441	        mask = load_offset < kv_end
442	        data = tl.load(token_pool + load_offset, mask=mask)
443	        tl.store(out_cache_ptr + save_offset, data, mask=mask)
444	        load_offset += BLOCK_SIZE
445	        save_offset += BLOCK_SIZE
446	
447	
448	def assign_extend_cache_locs_func(
449	    req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
450	    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
451	    start_offset: torch.Tensor,
452	    end_offset: torch.Tensor,
453	    batch_size: int,
454	    draft_token_num: int,
455	    device,
456	) -> torch.Tensor:
457	    if _is_cuda or _is_hip:
458	        out_cache_loc = torch.empty(
459	            (batch_size * draft_token_num,),
460	            dtype=torch.int64,
461	            device=device,
462	        )
463	        assign_extend_cache_locs[(batch_size,)](
464	            req_pool_indices,
465	            req_to_token,
466	            start_offset,
467	            end_offset,
468	            out_cache_loc,
469	            req_to_token.shape[1],
470	            next_power_of_2(batch_size),
471	        )
472	
473	        return out_cache_loc
474	
475	    elif _is_npu:
476	        out_cache_loc = torch.empty(
477	            (batch_size * draft_token_num,),
478	            dtype=torch.int32,
479	            device=device,
480	        )
481	        torch.ops.npu.cache_loc_update(
482	            req_pool_indices,
483	            req_to_token,
484	            start_offset,
485	            end_offset,
486	            out_cache_loc,
487	        )
488	
489	        return out_cache_loc
490

19	def organize_draft_results(
20	    score_list: List[torch.Tensor],
21	    token_list: List[torch.Tensor],
22	    parents_list: List[torch.Tensor],
23	    num_draft_token: int,
24	):
25	    score_list = torch.cat(score_list, dim=1).flatten(1)
26	    ss_token_list = torch.cat(token_list, dim=1)
27	    top_scores = torch.topk(score_list, num_draft_token - 1, dim=-1)
28	    top_scores_index = top_scores.indices
29	    top_scores_index = torch.sort(top_scores_index).values
30	    draft_tokens = torch.gather(ss_token_list, index=top_scores_index, dim=1)
31	
32	    if len(parents_list) > 1:
33	        parent_list = torch.cat(parents_list[:-1], dim=1)
34	    else:
35	        batch_size = parents_list[0].shape[0]
36	        parent_list = torch.empty(batch_size, 0, device=parents_list[0].device)
37	
38	    return parent_list, top_scores_index, draft_tokens
39

41	class TreeMaskMode(IntEnum):
42	    FULL_MASK = 0
43	    QLEN_ONLY = 1
44	    QLEN_ONLY_BITPACKING = 2
45	
46	
47	def build_tree_kernel_efficient(
48	    verified_id: torch.Tensor,
49	    parent_list: List[torch.Tensor],
50	    top_scores_index: torch.Tensor,
51	    draft_tokens: torch.Tensor,
52	    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
53	    seq_lens_sum: int,
54	    topk: int,
55	    spec_steps: int,
56	    num_verify_tokens: int,
57	    tree_mask_mode: TreeMaskMode = TreeMaskMode.FULL_MASK,
58	    tree_mask_buf: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
59	    position_buf: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
60	):
61	    draft_tokens = torch.cat((verified_id.unsqueeze(1), draft_tokens), dim=1).flatten()
62	
63	    # seq_lens_sum == sum(seq_lens); seq_lens: sequence length without draft tokens
64	    bs = seq_lens.numel()
65	    device = seq_lens.device
66	    # e.g. for bs=1, tree_mask: num_draft_token, seq_lens_sum + num_draft_token (flattened)
67	    # where each row indicates the attending pattern of each draft token
68	    # if use_partial_packed_tree_mask is True, tree_mask: num_draft_token (flattened, packed)
69	    if tree_mask_buf is not None:
70	        tree_mask = tree_mask_buf
71	        if tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.QLEN_ONLY:
72	            tree_mask.fill_(True)
73	        elif tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.QLEN_ONLY_BITPACKING:
74	            tree_mask.fill_(0)
75	        elif tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.FULL_MASK:
76	            tree_mask.fill_(True)
77	        else:
78	            raise NotImplementedError(f"Invalid tree mask: {tree_mask_mode=}")
79	    elif tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.QLEN_ONLY:
80	        tree_mask = torch.full(
81	            (num_verify_tokens * bs * num_verify_tokens,),
82	            True,
83	            dtype=torch.bool,
84	            device=device,
85	        )
86	    elif tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.QLEN_ONLY_BITPACKING:
87	        packed_dtypes = [torch.uint8, torch.uint16, torch.uint32]
88	        packed_dtype_idx = int(math.ceil(math.log2((num_verify_tokens + 7) // 8)))
89	        tree_mask = torch.zeros(
90	            (num_verify_tokens * bs,),
91	            dtype=packed_dtypes[packed_dtype_idx],
92	            device=device,
93	        )
94	    elif tree_mask_mode == TreeMaskMode.FULL_MASK:
95	        tree_mask = torch.full(
96	            (
97	                seq_lens_sum * num_verify_tokens
98	                + num_verify_tokens * num_verify_tokens * bs,
99	            ),
100	            True,
101	            device=device,
102	        )
103	    else:
104	        raise NotImplementedError(f"Invalid tree mask: {tree_mask_mode=}")
105	
106	    # TODO: make them torch.empty and fuse them into `sgl_build_tree_kernel`
107	    retrive_buf = torch.full(
108	        (3, bs, num_verify_tokens), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.long
109	    )
110	    retrive_index, retrive_next_token, retrive_next_sibling = retrive_buf
111	    # position: where each token belongs to
112	    # e.g. if depth of each draft token is [0, 1, 1, 2] and the prompt length is 7
113	    # then, positions = [7, 8, 8, 9]
114	    if position_buf is not None:
115	        positions = position_buf
116	    else:
117	        positions = torch.empty(
118	            (bs * num_verify_tokens,), device=device, dtype=torch.long
119	        )
120	
121	    if _is_npu:
122	        torch.ops.npu.build_tree_kernel_efficient(
123	            parent_list.to(dtype=torch.int64),
124	            top_scores_index,
125	            seq_lens,
126	            tree_mask,
127	            positions,
128	            retrive_index,
129	            retrive_next_token,
130	            retrive_next_sibling,
131	            topk,
132	            spec_steps,
133	            num_verify_tokens,
134	            tree_mask_mode,
135	        )

139	            top_scores_index,
140	            seq_lens,
141	            tree_mask,
142	            positions,
143	            retrive_index,
144	            retrive_next_token,
145	            retrive_next_sibling,
146	            topk,
147	            spec_steps,
148	            num_verify_tokens,
149	            tree_mask_mode,
150	        )

255	        }
256	        # Capture extend
257	        # TODO: support draft extend cuda graph for more attention backends
258	        if self.draft_extend_attn_backend and (
259	            _is_npu
260	            or (
261	                _is_cuda
262	                and isinstance(self.draft_attn_backend, TritonMultiStepDraftBackend)
263	            )
264	        ):
265	            tic = time.perf_counter()
266	            before_mem = get_available_gpu_memory(self.device, self.gpu_id)
267	            logger.info(
268	                f"Capture draft extend cuda graph begin. This can take up to several minutes. avail mem={before_mem:.2f} GB"
269	            )
270	            self.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend = Device2ExtendCudaGraphRunner[
271	                self.target_worker.device
272	            ](self)
273	            after_mem = get_available_gpu_memory(self.device, self.gpu_id)
274	            logger.info(
275	                f"Capture draft extend cuda graph end. Time elapsed: {time.perf_counter() - tic:.2f} s. mem usage={(before_mem - after_mem):.2f} GB. avail mem={after_mem:.2f} GB."
276	            )
277	
278	    def draft(self, model_worker_batch: ModelWorkerBatch):
279	        draft_input: EagleDraftInput = model_worker_batch.spec_info
280	        forward_batch, can_cuda_graph = draft_input.prepare_for_v2_draft(
281	            self.req_to_token_pool,
282	            model_worker_batch,
283	            self.cuda_graph_runner,
284	            self.draft_runner,
285	            self.topk,
286	            self.speculative_num_steps,
287	        )
288	
289	        # Run draft
290	        if can_cuda_graph:
291	            parent_list, top_scores_index, draft_tokens = self.cuda_graph_runner.replay(
292	                forward_batch,
293	            )
294	        else:
295	            if (
296	                not forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle()
297	                and self.speculative_num_steps > 1
298	            ):
299	                # Skip attention backend init for 1-step draft,
300	                # `draft_forward` only does sample in this case.
301	                self.draft_attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
302	            parent_list, top_scores_index, draft_tokens = self.draft_forward(
303	                forward_batch
304	            )
305	
306	        if model_worker_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
307	            return EagleVerifyInput.create_idle_input(
308	                self.topk,
309	                self.speculative_num_steps,
310	                self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
311	            )
312	
313	        # Build tree mask
314	        # Directly write to cuda graph buffers for verify attn
315	        tree_mask_buf, position_buf = (
316	            self.target_worker.model_runner.attn_backend.get_verify_buffers_to_fill_after_draft()
317	        )
318	
319	        (
320	            tree_mask,
321	            position,
322	            retrive_index,
323	            retrive_next_token,
324	            retrive_next_sibling,
325	            draft_tokens,
326	        ) = build_tree_kernel_efficient(
327	            draft_input.verified_id,
328	            parent_list,
329	            top_scores_index,
330	            draft_tokens,
331	            model_worker_batch.seq_lens,
332	            model_worker_batch.seq_lens_sum,
333	            self.topk,
334	            self.speculative_num_steps,
335	            self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
336	            self.tree_mask_mode,
337	            tree_mask_buf,
338	            position_buf,
339	        )
340	
341	        return EagleVerifyInput(
342	            draft_token=draft_tokens,
343	            custom_mask=tree_mask,
344	            positions=position,
345	            retrive_index=retrive_index,
346	            [REDACTED],
347	            retrive_next_sibling=retrive_next_sibling,
348	            retrive_cum_len=None,
349	            spec_steps=self.speculative_num_steps,
350	            topk=self.topk,
351	            draft_token_num=self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
352	            capture_hidden_mode=None,
353	            seq_lens_sum=None,
354	            seq_lens_cpu=None,
355	        )
356	
357	    def draft_forward(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
358	        # Parse args
359	        spec_info: EagleDraftInput = forward_batch.spec_info
360	        out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
361	        topk_p, topk_index, hidden_states = (
362	            spec_info.topk_p,
363	            spec_info.topk_index,
364	            spec_info.hidden_states,
365	        )
366	        if self.hot_token_id is not None:
367	            topk_index = self.hot_token_id[topk_index]
368	
369	        out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc.reshape(
370	            forward_batch.batch_size, self.topk, self.speculative_num_steps
371	        )
372	        out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc.permute((2, 0, 1)).reshape(
373	            self.speculative_num_steps, -1
374	        )
375	
376	        # Return values
377	        score_list: List[torch.Tensor] = []
378	        token_list: List[torch.Tensor] = []
379	        parents_list: List[torch.Tensor] = []
380	
381	        # Forward multiple steps
382	        scores = None
383	        for i in range(self.speculative_num_steps):
384	            input_ids, hidden_states, scores, tree_info = select_top_k_tokens(
385	                i, topk_p, topk_index, hidden_states, scores, self.topk
386	            )
387	            score_list.append(tree_info[0])
388	            token_list.append(tree_info[1])
389	            parents_list.append(tree_info[2])
390	
391	            # We don't need to run the last forward. we get 1 token from draft prefill and (#spec steps - 1) tokens here
392	            if i == self.speculative_num_steps - 1:
393	                break
394	
395	            # Set inputs
396	            forward_batch.input_ids = input_ids
397	            forward_batch.out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc[i]
398	            forward_batch.positions.add_(1)
399	            forward_batch.attn_backend = self.draft_attn_backend.attn_backends[i]
400	            spec_info.hidden_states = hidden_states
401	
402	            # Run forward
403	            logits_output = self.draft_runner.forward(
404	                forward_batch, skip_attn_backend_init=True
405	            ).logits_output
406	            if self.server_args.enable_nan_detection:
407	                detect_nan(logits_output)
408	            probs = torch.softmax(logits_output.next_token_logits, dim=-1)
409	            topk_p, topk_index = fast_topk(probs, self.topk, dim=-1)
410	            if self.hot_token_id is not None:
411	                topk_index = self.hot_token_id[topk_index]
412	            hidden_states = logits_output.hidden_states
413	
414	        # Organize the results
415	        score_list = torch.cat(score_list, dim=1).flatten(
416	            1
417	        )  # b, n, topk; n= 1 + (num_steps-1) * self.topk
418	        ss_token_list = torch.cat(
419	            token_list, dim=1
420	        )  # b, (self.topk + (num_steps-1) * self.topk)
421	        top_scores = torch.topk(
422	            score_list, self.speculative_num_draft_tokens - 1, dim=-1
423	        )
424	        top_scores_index = top_scores.indices
425	        top_scores_index = torch.sort(top_scores_index).values
426	        draft_tokens = torch.gather(ss_token_list, index=top_scores_index, dim=1)
427	
428	        if len(parents_list) > 1:
429	            parent_list = torch.cat(parents_list[:-1], dim=1)
430	        else:
431	            batch_size = parents_list[0].shape[0]
432	            parent_list = torch.empty(batch_size, 0, device=parents_list[0].device)
433	
434	        return parent_list, top_scores_index, draft_tokens
435	
436	    def draft_extend(self):
437	        pass
438	
439	    def _draft_extend_for_prefill(
440	        self,
441	        batch: ModelWorkerBatch,
442	        target_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
443	        next_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
444	    ):
445	        """
446	        Run draft model extend to correctly fill the KV cache.
447	
448	        Args:
449	            batch: The batch to run.
450	            target_hidden_states: Hidden states from the target model forward
451	            next_token_ids: Next token ids generated from the target forward.
452	        """
453	        # Construct input_ids
454	        if not batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
455	            pt = 0
456	            for i, extend_len in enumerate(batch.extend_seq_lens):
457	                input_ids = batch.input_ids[pt : pt + extend_len]
458	                batch.input_ids[pt : pt + extend_len] = torch.cat(
459	                    (input_ids[1:], next_token_ids[i].reshape(1))
460	                )
461	                pt += extend_len
462	
463	        # Construct spec_info
464	        next_draft_input = EagleDraftInput(
465	            hidden_states=target_hidden_states,
466	            verified_id=next_token_ids,
467	            new_seq_lens=batch.seq_lens,
468	            # draft mode is same with decode mode, only 1 num token per batch
469	            num_tokens_per_batch=1,
470	            num_tokens_for_logprob_per_batch=1,
471	        )
472	
473	        batch.spec_info = next_draft_input
474	
475	        # Run forward
476	        forward_batch = ForwardBatch.init_new(batch, self.draft_runner)
477	        logits_output = self.draft_runner.forward(forward_batch).logits_output
478	
479	        # Update spec_info for the next draft step
480	        probs = torch.softmax(logits_output.next_token_logits, dim=-1)
481	        next_draft_input.topk_p, next_draft_input.topk_index = fast_topk(
482	            probs, self.topk, dim=-1
483	        )
484	        next_draft_input.hidden_states = logits_output.hidden_states
485	        return next_draft_input
486	
487	    def _draft_extend_for_decode(
488	        self, batch: ModelWorkerBatch, batch_result: GenerationBatchResult
489	    ):
490	        # Batch 2: Draft extend
491	        draft_input = EagleDraftInput(
492	            hidden_states=batch_result.logits_output.hidden_states,
493	            num_tokens_per_batch=self.speculative_num_steps + 1,
494	            num_tokens_for_logprob_per_batch=self.speculative_num_steps + 1,
495	        )
496	        select_index = (
497	            torch.arange(len(batch.seq_lens), device=self.device)
498	            * self.speculative_num_draft_tokens
499	            + batch_result.accept_lens
500	            - 1
501	        )
502	
503	        # Prepare for draft extend in a separate stream
504	        with self.plan_stream_ctx:
505	            forward_batch = draft_input.prepare_for_extend_to_fill_draft_kvcache(
506	                batch,
507	                batch_result.next_token_ids,
508	                self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
509	                self.draft_runner,
510	                self.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend,
511	            )
512	
513	        if self.plan_stream:
514	            torch.get_device_module(self.device).current_stream().wait_stream(
515	                self.plan_stream
516	            )
517	
518	        if forward_batch.spec_info.accept_length is None:
519	            forward_batch.spec_info.accept_length = batch_result.accept_lens
520	
521	        # Run draft extend batch in the main compute stream
522	        can_cuda_graph = (
523	            self.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend
524	            and self.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend.can_run(forward_batch)
525	        )
526	        if can_cuda_graph:
527	            draft_logits_output = self.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend.replay(
528	                forward_batch
529	            )
530	        else:
531	            draft_logits_output = self.draft_runner.forward(
532	                forward_batch, skip_attn_backend_init=True
533	            ).logits_output
534	
535	        # Reorganize the spec info for the next batch
536	        draft_logits_output.next_token_logits = draft_logits_output.next_token_logits[
537	            select_index
538	        ]
539	        draft_logits_output.hidden_states = draft_logits_output.hidden_states[
540	            select_index
541	        ]
542	        probs = torch.softmax(draft_logits_output.next_token_logits, dim=-1)
543	        ret_topk_p, ret_topk_index = fast_topk(probs, self.topk, dim=-1)
544	        ret_hidden_states = draft_logits_output.hidden_states
545	
546	        # Construct the return values
547	        next_draft_input = batch_result.next_draft_input
548	        (
549	            next_draft_input.topk_p,
550	            next_draft_input.topk_index,
551	            next_draft_input.hidden_states,
552	        ) = (
553	            ret_topk_p,
554	            ret_topk_index,
555	            ret_hidden_states,
556	        )
